### bigquery/functions/aggregate/max_by	returns value at the maximum key
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`$agg1__2` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_any_value(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_5`.`value`, 0), zetasqlite_having_max(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_5`.`value`, 1))) AS `$agg1__2`  
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e030f02046e616d650405616c6963650573636f7265010a000000000000000f02046e616d650403626f620573636f7265011e000000000000000f02046e616d6504056361726f6c0573636f7265011400000000000000') AS `$array_5`
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`;

### bigquery/functions/aggregate/max_by	tie on the by-value — first-encountered row wins
SELECT
`$agg1__2` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_any_value(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_5`.`value`, 0), zetasqlite_having_max(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_5`.`value`, 1))) AS `$agg1__2`  
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e030f02046e616d650405616c6963650573636f7265011e000000000000000f02046e616d650403626f620573636f7265011e000000000000000f02046e616d6504056361726f6c0573636f7265011400000000000000') AS `$array_5`
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`;

### bigquery/functions/aggregate/max_by	NULL keys are skipped, returns value at the highest non-NULL key
SELECT
`$agg1__2` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_any_value(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_5`.`value`, 0), zetasqlite_having_max(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_5`.`value`, 1))) AS `$agg1__2`  
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(zetasqlite_make_array(zetasqlite_make_struct(X'606e616d65', X'60616c696365', X'6073636f7265', null), X'0f02046e616d650403626f620573636f7265011e00000000000000')) AS `$array_5`
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`;

### bigquery/functions/aggregate/max_by	MAX_BY inside a GROUP BY query
SELECT
`cat__4` AS `cat`,  
`mx__2` AS `mx`
FROM (
SELECT  
`cat__4`,    
`mx__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`cat__3` AS `cat__4`,      
zetasqlite_any_value(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$unnest1__1`, 0), zetasqlite_having_max(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$unnest1__1`, 1))) AS `mx__2`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`$array_6`.`value` AS `$unnest1__1`,        
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 2) AS `cat__3`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e030f03046e616d650405616c6963650573636f7265010500000000000000036361740404636174310f03046e616d650403626f620573636f7265010a00000000000000036361740404636174310f03046e616d6504056361726f6c0573636f726501010000000000000003636174040463617432') AS `$array_6`
) AS `project_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`cat__3`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `cat__4` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### bigquery/functions/aggregate/max_by	MAX_BY with a WHERE filter (precondition for HAVING-style usage)
SELECT
`$agg1__2` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_any_value(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0), zetasqlite_having_max(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 1))) AS `$agg1__2`  
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e030f03046e616d650405616c6963650573636f7265010500000000000000036361740404636174310f03046e616d650403626f620573636f7265010a00000000000000036361740404636174310f03046e616d6504056361726f6c0573636f726501010000000000000003636174040463617432') AS `$array_6`  
WHERE zetasqlite_equal(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 2), X'6063617431')
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`;

### googlesql/functions/aggregate/any_value	upstream Example — ANY_VALUE returns one row from the group
SELECT
`picked__3` AS `picked`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_not(zetasqlite_is_null(`$agg1__2`)) AS `picked__3`  
FROM (
SELECT    
zetasqlite_any_value(`$array_5`.`value`) AS `$agg1__2`    
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e0304056170706c65040662616e616e61040470656172') AS `$array_5`
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/aggregate/any_value	HAVING MAX picks the value associated with the largest sold count
SELECT
`ok__14` AS `ok`
FROM (
WITH `Store` AS 	(  
SELECT    
20 AS `sold__9`,      
X'606170706c6573' AS `fruit__10`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
30 AS `sold__9`,      
X'607065617273' AS `fruit__10`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
30 AS `sold__9`,      
X'6062616e616e6173' AS `fruit__10`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
10 AS `sold__9`,      
X'606f72616e676573' AS `fruit__10`  )
  
SELECT  
zetasqlite_in(`$agg1__13`, X'607065617273', X'6062616e616e6173') AS `ok__14`  
FROM (
SELECT    
zetasqlite_any_value(`wrs20`.`fruit__10`, zetasqlite_having_max(`wrs20`.`sold__9`)) AS `$agg1__13`    
FROM `Store` AS `wrs20`
) AS `aggregate_scan_19`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/aggregate/any_value	HAVING MIN picks the value associated with the smallest sold count
WITH `Store` AS 	(
SELECT  
20 AS `sold__9`,    
X'606170706c6573' AS `fruit__10`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
30 AS `sold__9`,    
X'607065617273' AS `fruit__10`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
30 AS `sold__9`,    
X'6062616e616e6173' AS `fruit__10`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
10 AS `sold__9`,    
X'606f72616e676573' AS `fruit__10`)

SELECT
`a_lowest_selling_fruit__13` AS `a_lowest_selling_fruit`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_any_value(`wrs20`.`fruit__10`, zetasqlite_having_min(`wrs20`.`sold__9`)) AS `a_lowest_selling_fruit__13`  
FROM `Store` AS `wrs20`
) AS `aggregate_scan_19`;

### googlesql/functions/aggregate/any_value	ANY_VALUE inside a GROUP BY query
SELECT
`cat__4` AS `cat`,  
`picked__5` AS `picked`
FROM (
SELECT  
`cat__4`,    
`picked__5`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`cat__4`,      
`$agg1__2`,      
zetasqlite_not(zetasqlite_is_null(`$agg1__2`)) AS `picked__5`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`cat__3` AS `cat__4`,        
zetasqlite_any_value(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$unnest1__1`, 0)) AS `$agg1__2`      
FROM (
SELECT        
`$array_7`.`value` AS `$unnest1__1`,          
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_7`.`value`, 1) AS `cat__3`        
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e030f02046e616d650405616c696365036361740404636174310f02046e616d650403626f62036361740404636174310f02046e616d6504056361726f6c03636174040463617432') AS `$array_7`
) AS `project_scan_6`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`cat__3`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_5`
) AS `project_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `cat__4` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_array_concat_agg(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0)) AS `$agg1__2`  
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e010f01036172720e02010100000000000000010200000000000000') AS `$array_6`  
WHERE false
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`;

### googlesql/functions/aggregate/grouping	upstream example 1
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`product_type__22` AS `product_type`,  
`product_name__23` AS `product_name`,  
`product_sum__19` AS `product_sum`,  
`$grouping_call1__24` AS `product_type_agg`,  
`$grouping_call2__25` AS `product_name_agg`
FROM (
WITH `Products` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'607368697274' AS `product_type__13`,      
X'60742d7368697274' AS `product_name__14`,      
3 AS `product_count__15`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'607368697274' AS `product_type__13`,      
X'60742d7368697274' AS `product_name__14`,      
8 AS `product_count__15`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'607368697274' AS `product_type__13`,      
X'60706f6c6f' AS `product_name__14`,      
25 AS `product_count__15`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'6070616e7473' AS `product_type__13`,      
X'606a65616e73' AS `product_name__14`,      
6 AS `product_count__15`  )
  
SELECT  
`product_type__22`,    
`product_name__23`,    
`product_sum__19`,    
`$grouping_call1__24`,    
`$grouping_call2__25`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`product_type__22`,      
`product_name` AS `product_name__23`,      
`product_sum__19`,      
`$grouping_call1__24`,      
`$grouping_call2__25`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`wrs20`.`product_type__13` AS `product_type__22`,        
NULL AS `product_name`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs20`.`product_count__15`) AS `product_sum__19`,        
0 AS `$grouping_call1__24`,        
1 AS `$grouping_call2__25`      
FROM `Products` AS `wrs20`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs20`.`product_type__13`)      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
NULL AS `product_type`,        
`wrs20`.`product_name__14` AS `product_name__23`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs20`.`product_count__15`) AS `product_sum__19`,        
1 AS `$grouping_call1__24`,        
0 AS `$grouping_call2__25`      
FROM `Products` AS `wrs20`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs20`.`product_name__14`)      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
NULL AS `product_type`,        
NULL AS `product_name`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs20`.`product_count__15`) AS `product_sum__19`,        
1 AS `$grouping_call1__24`,        
1 AS `$grouping_call2__25`      
FROM `Products` AS `wrs20`      
GROUP BY NULL      
ORDER BY `wrs20`.`product_name__14` ASC, `wrs20`.`product_type__13` ASC
) AS `set_op_scan_inner`
) AS `aggregate_scan_19`  
ORDER BY `product_name__23` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/aggregate/grouping	upstream example 2
SELECT
`product_type__22` AS `product_type`,  
`product_name__23` AS `product_name`,  
`product_sum__20` AS `product_sum`,  
`$grouping_call1__24` AS `product_type_is_aggregated`
FROM (
WITH `Products` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'607368697274' AS `product_type__13`,      
X'60742d7368697274' AS `product_name__14`,      
3 AS `product_count__15`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'607368697274' AS `product_type__13`,      
X'60742d7368697274' AS `product_name__14`,      
8 AS `product_count__15`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
null AS `product_type__13`,      
X'60706f6c6f' AS `product_name__14`,      
25 AS `product_count__15`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'6070616e7473' AS `product_type__13`,      
X'606a65616e73' AS `product_name__14`,      
6 AS `product_count__15`  )
  
SELECT  
`product_type__22`,    
`product_name__23`,    
`product_sum__20`,    
`$grouping_call1__24`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`product_type__22`,      
`product_name` AS `product_name__23`,      
`product_sum__20`,      
`$grouping_call1__24`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`wrs21`.`product_type__13` AS `product_type__22`,        
NULL AS `product_name`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs21`.`product_count__15`) AS `product_sum__20`,        
0 AS `$grouping_call1__24`      
FROM `Products` AS `wrs21`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs21`.`product_type__13`)      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
NULL AS `product_type`,        
`wrs21`.`product_name__14` AS `product_name__23`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs21`.`product_count__15`) AS `product_sum__20`,        
1 AS `$grouping_call1__24`      
FROM `Products` AS `wrs21`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs21`.`product_name__14`)      
ORDER BY `wrs21`.`product_name__14` ASC, `wrs21`.`product_type__13` ASC
) AS `set_op_scan_inner`
) AS `aggregate_scan_20`  
ORDER BY `product_name__23` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/aggregate/logical_and	all true
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`$agg1__2` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT

FROM (

`$array_11`.`value` AS `e__3`,          
`$array_11`.`key` AS `idx__4`        
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000') AS `$array_11`        
WHERE zetasqlite_not(zetasqlite_is_null(`$array_11`.`value`))
) AS `filter_scan_10`      
ORDER BY `e__3` DESC, `idx__4` ASC      
LIMIT 1) END AS `$col1__5`) AS `$col1__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/array/array_slice	slice middle of array
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_to_json_string((SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_or(zetasqlite_is_null(X'0e05010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000010400000000000000010500000000000000'), zetasqlite_is_null(1), zetasqlite_is_null(3)) THEN null WHEN zetasqlite_equal(zetasqlite_array_length(X'0e05010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000010400000000000000010500000000000000'), 0) THEN X'0e00' ELSE (SELECT      
(SELECT        
zetasqlite_array(`e__7`)        
FROM (
SELECT          
`e__7`          
FROM (
SELECT            
`$array_14`.`value` AS `e__7`,              
`$array_14`.`key` AS `idx__8`            
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e05010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000010400000000000000010500000000000000') AS `$array_14`            
WHERE zetasqlite_between(`$array_14`.`key`, `start_offset__5`, `end_offset__6`)
) AS `filter_scan_13`          
ORDER BY `idx__8` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_12`) AS `injected__10`      
FROM (
SELECT        
`start_offset__5`,          
CASE WHEN 3 < 0 THEN zetasqlite_add(3, zetasqlite_array_length(X'0e05010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000010400000000000000010500000000000000')) ELSE 3 END AS `end_offset__6`        
FROM (
SELECT          
CASE WHEN 1 < 0 THEN zetasqlite_add(1, zetasqlite_array_length(X'0e05010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000010400000000000000010500000000000000')) ELSE 1 END AS `start_offset__5`
) AS `project_scan_10`
) AS `project_scan_9`) END AS `$col1__9`)) AS `$col1__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/conversion/parse_bignumeric	a 39th fractional digit rounds into scale 38, ties away from zero
SELECT
`up__1` AS `up`,  
`tie__2` AS `tie`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_cast(zetasqlite_parse_bignumeric(X'60312e313233343536373839303132333435363738393031323334353637383930313233343536373839'), X'607b226e616d65223a22222c226b696e64223a32342c227369676e61747572654b696e64223a302c22656c656d656e7454797065223a6e756c6c2c226669656c645479706573223a6e756c6c7d', X'607b226e616d65223a22222c226b696e64223a382c227369676e61747572654b696e64223a302c22656c656d656e7454797065223a6e756c6c2c226669656c645479706573223a6e756c6c7d', false) AS `up__1`,    
zetasqlite_cast(zetasqlite_parse_bignumeric(X'602d312e313233343536373839303132333435363738393031323334353637383930313233343536373835'), X'607b226e616d65223a22222c226b696e64223a32342c227369676e61747572654b696e64223a302c22656c656d656e7454797065223a6e756c6c2c226669656c645479706573223a6e756c6c7d', X'607b226e616d65223a22222c226b696e64223a382c227369676e61747572654b696e64223a302c22656c656d656e7454797065223a6e756c6c2c226669656c645479706573223a6e756c6c7d', false) AS `tie__2`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/hll/hll_count_extract	HLL_COUNT.EXTRACT through INIT pipeline returns approximate cardinality
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`$col1__3` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_greater_or_equal(zetasqlite_hll_count_extract(`$agg1__2`), 0) AS `$col1__3`  
FROM (
SELECT    
zetasqlite_hll_count_init(`$array_5`.`value`) AS `$agg1__2`    
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000') AS `$array_5`
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/hll/hll_count_init	HLL_COUNT.INIT produces a non-empty sketch
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`$col1__3` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_greater(zetasqlite_byte_length(`$agg1__2`), 0) AS `$col1__3`  
FROM (
SELECT    
zetasqlite_hll_count_init(`$array_5`.`value`) AS `$agg1__2`    
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000') AS `$array_5`
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/hll/hll_count_merge	upstream example 1
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`distinct_customers_with_open_invoice__4` AS `distinct_customers_with_open_invoice`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_hll_count_merge(`hll_sketch__2`) AS `distinct_customers_with_open_invoice__4`  
FROM (
SELECT    
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_7`.`value`, 0) AS `country__3`,      
zetasqlite_hll_count_init(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_7`.`value`, 1)) AS `hll_sketch__2`    
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'') AS `$array_7`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_7`.`value`, 0))
) AS `aggregate_scan_6`
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`;

### googlesql/functions/hll/hll_count_merge_partial	upstream example 1

### googlesql/functions/hll/hll_count_merge_partial	a merged sketch still counts the distinct inputs
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`extracted__6` AS `extracted`,  
`merged__5` AS `merged`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_hll_count_extract(`$agg1__4`) AS `extracted__6`,    
`merged__5`  
FROM (
SELECT    
zetasqlite_hll_count_merge_partial(`hll_sketch__2`) AS `$agg1__4`,      
zetasqlite_hll_count_merge(`hll_sketch__2`) AS `merged__5`    
FROM (
SELECT      
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_7`.`value`, 0) AS `country__3`,        
zetasqlite_hll_count_init(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_7`.`value`, 1)) AS `hll_sketch__2`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'') AS `$array_7`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_7`.`value`, 0))
) AS `aggregate_scan_6`
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/range/generate_range_array	upstream example 1 — 1-day buckets covering the full range
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`results__1` AS `results`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_generate_range_array(zetasqlite_range(X'408000000000004756', X'40800000000000475b'), zetasqlite_interval(1, X'60444159'), true) AS `results__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/range/generate_range_array	upstream example 2 — 2-day buckets, trailing bucket clipped to the end
SELECT
`results__1` AS `results`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_generate_range_array(zetasqlite_range(X'408000000000004756', X'40800000000000475b'), zetasqlite_interval(2, X'60444159'), true) AS `results__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/range/generate_range_array	upstream example 3 — 2-day buckets with explicit `last_partial_range = TRUE`
SELECT
`results__1` AS `results`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_generate_range_array(zetasqlite_range(X'408000000000004756', X'40800000000000475b'), zetasqlite_interval(2, X'60444159'), true) AS `results__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/range/generate_range_array	upstream example 4 — `last_partial_range = FALSE` drops the trailing partial
SELECT
`results__1` AS `results`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_generate_range_array(zetasqlite_range(X'408000000000004756', X'40800000000000475b'), zetasqlite_interval(2, X'60444159'), false) AS `results__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/range/range_sessionize	upstream example 1
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
CREATE TABLE `mydataset_my_sessionized_range_table` (`emp_id` INT,`dept_id` INT,`duration` TEXT) ;
INSERT INTO `mydataset_my_sessionized_range_table`
 (`emp_id`, `dept_id`, `duration`) 
VALUES 
(10,1000,X'800101800000000000391b008000000000003956'),(10,2000,X'80010180000000000039560080000000000039d5'),(10,2000,X'80010180000000000039b70080000000000039f7'),(20,2000,X'80010180000000000039560080000000000039da'),(20,1000,X'80010180000000000047d800800000000000485d');
SELECT
`emp_id__1` AS `emp_id`,  
`dept_id__2` AS `dept_id`,  
`duration__3` AS `duration`
FROM (
SELECT  
`emp_id__1`,    
`dept_id__2`,    
`duration__3`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`emp_id` AS `emp_id__1`,      
`dept_id` AS `dept_id__2`,      
`duration` AS `duration__3`    
FROM `mydataset_my_sessionized_range_table`
) AS `table_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `emp_id__1` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/security/session_user	SESSION_USER returns a non-NULL identifier
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_not(zetasqlite_is_null(zetasqlite_session_user())) AS `$col1__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/string/collate	upstream example 2
WITH `Words` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'6061' AS `char1__1`,    
X'605a' AS `char2__2`)

SELECT
`wrs8`.`char1__1` < `wrs8`.`char2__2` AS `a_less_than_Z`
FROM `Words` AS `wrs8`;

### googlesql/functions/window/cume_dist	cumulative distribution over a 3-row partition
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`$col1__4` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_is_nan(`$analytic1__3`) AS `$col1__4`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`x__1`,      
zetasqlite_window_cume_dist() OVER (ORDER BY `x__1` ASC GROUPS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `$analytic1__3`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`$array_6`.`value` AS `x__1`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000') AS `$array_6`
) AS `array_scan_6`    
ORDER BY `x__1` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_5`  
LIMIT 1
) AS `limit_scan_3`;

### googlesql/functions/window/dense_rank	dense_rank with ties
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`x__1` AS `x`,  
`r__3` AS `r`
FROM (
SELECT  
`x__1`,    
`r__3`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`x__1`,      
zetasqlite_window_dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY `x__1` ASC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `r__3`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`$array_5`.`value` AS `x__1`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e04010a00000000000000011400000000000000011400000000000000011e00000000000000') AS `$array_5`
) AS `array_scan_5`    
ORDER BY `x__1` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `x__1` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`x__1` AS `x`,  
`rn__3` AS `rn`
FROM (
SELECT  
`x__1`,    
`rn__3`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`x__1`,      
zetasqlite_window_row_number() OVER (ORDER BY `x__1` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `rn__3`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`$array_5`.`value` AS `x__1`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e03010a00000000000000011400000000000000011e00000000000000') AS `$array_5`
) AS `array_scan_5`    
ORDER BY `x__1` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `x__1` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

`column_name` AS `column_name__4`,

### googlesql/syntax/cte/with_recursive	count 1..5 with recursive CTE
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`n__5` AS `n`
FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE `numbers` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `n__2`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
zetasqlite_add(`rrs12`.`n__2`, 1) AS `n__2`    
FROM `numbers` AS `rrs12`    
WHERE `rrs12`.`n__2` < 5  )
  
SELECT  
`n__5`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs14`.`n__2` AS `n__5`    
FROM `numbers` AS `wrs14`
) AS `with_ref_scan_14`  
ORDER BY `n__5` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/cte/with_recursive	count down with recursive CTE
SELECT
`n__5` AS `n`
FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE `down` AS 	(  
SELECT    
3 AS `n__2`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
zetasqlite_subtract(`rrs12`.`n__2`, 1) AS `n__2`    
FROM `down` AS `rrs12`    
WHERE `rrs12`.`n__2` > 1  )
  
SELECT  
`n__5`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs14`.`n__2` AS `n__5`    
FROM `down` AS `wrs14`
) AS `with_ref_scan_14`  
ORDER BY `n__5` DESC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/cte/with_recursive	factorial via recursive CTE
SELECT
`n__9` AS `n`,  
`fact__10` AS `fact`
FROM (
WITH RECURSIVE `f` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `n__3`,      
1 AS `fact__4`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
zetasqlite_add(`rrs12`.`n__3`, 1) AS `n__3`,      
zetasqlite_multiply(`rrs12`.`fact__4`, zetasqlite_add(`rrs12`.`n__3`, 1)) AS `fact__4`    
FROM `f` AS `rrs12`    
WHERE `rrs12`.`n__3` < 5  )
  
SELECT  
`n__9`,    
`fact__10`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs14`.`n__3` AS `n__9`,      
`wrs14`.`fact__4` AS `fact__10`    
FROM `f` AS `wrs14`
) AS `with_ref_scan_14`  
ORDER BY `n__9` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/dml/delete	DELETE removes rows matching a WHERE predicate

 (`a`, `b`) 
VALUES 
(1,X'6078'),(2,X'6079'),(3,X'607a');
DELETE FROM `del_ds_t` WHERE `a` = 2;
SELECT
`a__1` AS `a`,  
`b__2` AS `b`
FROM (
SELECT  
`a__1`,    
`b__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`a` AS `a__1`,      
`b` AS `b__2`    
FROM `del_ds_t`
) AS `table_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `a__1` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/dml/merge	MERGE upstream Inventory + NewArrivals walkthrough
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
CREATE TABLE `merge_ds_NewArrivals` (`product` TEXT,`quantity` INT,`warehouse` TEXT) ;
CREATE TABLE `merge_ds_Inventory` (`product` TEXT,`quantity` INT) ;
INSERT INTO `merge_ds_NewArrivals`
 (`product`, `quantity`, `warehouse`) 
VALUES 
(X'606472796572',20,X'6077617265686f757365202332'),(X'606f76656e',30,X'6077617265686f757365202333'),(X'60726566726967657261746f72',25,X'6077617265686f757365202332'),(X'60746f70206c6f616420776173686572',10,X'6077617265686f757365202331');
INSERT INTO `merge_ds_Inventory`
 (`product`, `quantity`) 
VALUES 
(X'6064697368776173686572',30),(X'606472796572',30),(X'6066726f6e74206c6f616420776173686572',20),(X'606d6963726f77617665',20),(X'606f76656e',5),(X'60746f70206c6f616420776173686572',10);
CREATE TABLE `zetasqlite_merged_table` AS SELECT DISTINCT
*
FROM (
SELECT  
`product__3` AS `merged_source_product`,    
`quantity__4` AS `merged_source_quantity`,    
`warehouse__5` AS `merged_source_warehouse`,    
`product__1` AS `merged_target_product`,    
`quantity__2` AS `merged_target_quantity`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`product` AS `product__3`,      
`quantity` AS `quantity__4`,      
`warehouse` AS `warehouse__5`    
FROM `merge_ds_NewArrivals` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`product` AS `product__1`,      
`quantity` AS `quantity__2`    
FROM `merge_ds_Inventory` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` ON `product__1` = `product__3`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`product__3` AS `merged_source_product`,    
`quantity__4` AS `merged_source_quantity`,    
`warehouse__5` AS `merged_source_warehouse`,    
`product__1` AS `merged_target_product`,    
`quantity__2` AS `merged_target_quantity`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`product` AS `product__1`,      
`quantity` AS `quantity__2`    
FROM `merge_ds_Inventory` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`product` AS `product__3`,      
`quantity` AS `quantity__4`,      
`warehouse` AS `warehouse__5`    
FROM `merge_ds_NewArrivals` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` ON `product__1` = `product__3`
) AS `merged_union`;
UPDATE `merge_ds_Inventory` SET `quantity`= zetasqlite_add(`merged_target_quantity`, `merged_source_quantity`) FROM zetasqlite_merged_table WHERE `merged_source_product` = `product` AND `merged_target_product` = `product`;
INSERT INTO `merge_ds_Inventory` (`product`,`quantity`) SELECT `product__3` AS `product`,`quantity__4` AS `quantity` FROM (
SELECT  
`product` AS `product__3`,    
`quantity` AS `quantity__4`,    
`warehouse` AS `warehouse__5`  
FROM `merge_ds_NewArrivals` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zetasqlite_merged_table WHERE `merged_source_product` = `product__3` AND `merged_target_product` IS NOT NULL);
DROP TABLE zetasqlite_merged_table;
SELECT
`product__1` AS `product`,  
`quantity__2` AS `quantity`
FROM (
SELECT  
`product__1`,    
`quantity__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`product` AS `product__1`,      
`quantity` AS `quantity__2`    
FROM `merge_ds_Inventory`
) AS `table_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `product__1` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/dml/merge	MERGE on a non-equality ON predicate
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
CREATE TABLE `merge_ds_thresholds` (`label` TEXT,`threshold` INT) ;
CREATE TABLE `merge_ds_reading` (`value` INT) ;
INSERT INTO `merge_ds_thresholds`
 (`label`, `threshold`)

### googlesql/syntax/dml/merge	MERGE WHEN MATCHED THEN DELETE
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
CREATE TABLE `merge_ds_t3` (`k` INT,`v` TEXT) ;
CREATE TABLE `merge_ds_s3` (`k` INT) ;
INSERT INTO `merge_ds_t3`
 (`k`, `v`) 
VALUES 
(1,X'6061'),(2,X'6062'),(3,X'6063');
INSERT INTO `merge_ds_s3`
 (`k`) 
VALUES 
(1),(3);
CREATE TABLE `zetasqlite_merged_table` AS SELECT DISTINCT
*
FROM (
SELECT  
`k__3` AS `merged_source_k`,    
`k__1` AS `merged_target_k`,    
`v__2` AS `merged_target_v`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__3`    
FROM `merge_ds_s3` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__1`,      
`v` AS `v__2`    
FROM `merge_ds_t3` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` ON `k__1` = `k__3`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`k__3` AS `merged_source_k`,    
`k__1` AS `merged_target_k`,    
`v__2` AS `merged_target_v`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__1`,      
`v` AS `v__2`    
FROM `merge_ds_t3` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__3`    
FROM `merge_ds_s3` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` ON `k__1` = `k__3`
) AS `merged_union`;
DELETE FROM `merge_ds_t3` WHERE EXISTS (SELECT `merged_source_k`, `merged_target_k` FROM `zetasqlite_merged_table` WHERE `merged_source_k` = `k` AND `merged_target_k` = `k`);
DROP TABLE zetasqlite_merged_table;
SELECT
`k__1` AS `k`,  
`v__2` AS `v`
FROM (
SELECT  
`k__1`,    
`v__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__1`,      
`v` AS `v__2`    
FROM `merge_ds_t3`
) AS `table_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `k__1` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

CREATE TABLE `merge_ds_t4` (`k` INT,`v` INT) ;

INSERT INTO `merge_ds_s4`
 (`k`, `w`) 
VALUES 
(1,100),(2,5),(3,999);
CREATE TABLE `zetasqlite_merged_table` AS SELECT DISTINCT
*
FROM (
SELECT  
`k__3` AS `merged_source_k`,    
`w__4` AS `merged_source_w`,    
`k__1` AS `merged_target_k`,    
`v__2` AS `merged_target_v`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__3`,      
`w` AS `w__4`    
FROM `merge_ds_s4` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__1`,      
`v` AS `v__2`    
FROM `merge_ds_t4` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` ON `k__1` = `k__3`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`k__3` AS `merged_source_k`,    
`w__4` AS `merged_source_w`,    
`k__1` AS `merged_target_k`,    
`v__2` AS `merged_target_v`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__1`,      
`v` AS `v__2`    
FROM `merge_ds_t4` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__3`,      
`w` AS `w__4`    
FROM `merge_ds_s4` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` ON `k__1` = `k__3`
) AS `merged_union`;
UPDATE `merge_ds_t4` SET `v`= `merged_source_w` FROM zetasqlite_merged_table WHERE `merged_source_k` = `k` AND `merged_target_k` = `k` AND (`merged_source_w` > 50);
DROP TABLE zetasqlite_merged_table;
SELECT
`k__1` AS `k`,

`k__1`,    
`v__2`

`v` AS `v__2`    
FROM `merge_ds_t4`
) AS `table_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `k__1` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/dml/merge	MERGE WHEN NOT MATCHED BY TARGET AND search_condition THEN INSERT
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
CREATE TABLE `merge_ds_t5` (`k` INT) ;
CREATE TABLE `merge_ds_s5` (`k` INT,`eligible` BOOLEAN) ;
INSERT INTO `merge_ds_t5`
 (`k`) 
VALUES 
(1);
INSERT INTO `merge_ds_s5`
 (`k`, `eligible`) 
VALUES 
(2,true),(3,false),(4,true);
CREATE TABLE `zetasqlite_merged_table` AS SELECT DISTINCT
*
FROM (
SELECT  
`k__2` AS `merged_source_k`,    
`eligible__3` AS `merged_source_eligible`,    
`k__1` AS `merged_target_k`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__2`,      
`eligible` AS `eligible__3`    
FROM `merge_ds_s5` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__1`    
FROM `merge_ds_t5` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` ON `k__1` = `k__2`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`k__2` AS `merged_source_k`,    
`eligible__3` AS `merged_source_eligible`,    
`k__1` AS `merged_target_k`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__1`    
FROM `merge_ds_t5` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__2`,      
`eligible` AS `eligible__3`    
FROM `merge_ds_s5` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` ON `k__1` = `k__2`
) AS `merged_union`;
INSERT INTO `merge_ds_t5` (`k`) SELECT `k__2` AS `k` FROM (
SELECT  
`k` AS `k__2`,    
`eligible` AS `eligible__3`  
FROM `merge_ds_s5` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zetasqlite_merged_table WHERE `merged_source_k` = `k__2` AND `merged_target_k` IS NOT NULL) AND (`eligible__3`);
DROP TABLE zetasqlite_merged_table;
SELECT
`k__1` AS `k`
FROM (
SELECT  
`k__1`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`k` AS `k__1`    
FROM `merge_ds_t5`
) AS `table_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `k__1` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/dml/update	UPDATE WHERE TRUE updates every row

`a__1`,

ORDER BY `a__1` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/io/export_data	EXPORT DATA OPTIONS(...) AS SELECT writes to the URI and yields no rows
PRAGMA user_version;

### googlesql/syntax/pipe/aggregate	count rows with no GROUP BY
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`n__5` AS `n`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_count_star() AS `n__5`  
FROM (
SELECT    
1 AS `x__4`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
2 AS `x__4`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
3 AS `x__4`
) AS `set_op_scan_4`
) AS `aggregate_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/pipe/aggregate	aggregate with GROUP BY
SELECT
`category__12` AS `category`,  
`total__11` AS `total`
FROM (
SELECT  
`category__12`,    
`total__11`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`category__9` AS `category__12`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`sales__10`) AS `total__11`    
FROM (
SELECT      
X'606672756974' AS `category__9`,        
2 AS `sales__10`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'606672756974' AS `category__9`,        
7 AS `sales__10`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'606672756974' AS `category__9`,        
5 AS `sales__10`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__9`,        
8 AS `sales__10`
) AS `set_op_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`category__9`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `category__12` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/pipe/join	inner join on equality
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`id__5` AS `id`,  
`lhs__6` AS `lhs`,  
`rhs__12` AS `rhs`
FROM (
SELECT  
`id__5`,    
`lhs__6`,    
`id__11`,    
`rhs__12`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id__5`,      
`lhs__6`,      
`id__11`,      
`rhs__12`    
FROM (
SELECT      
1 AS `id__5`,        
X'6061' AS `lhs__6`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
2 AS `id__5`,        
X'6062' AS `lhs__6`
) AS `set_op_scan_5` INNER JOIN (
SELECT      
1 AS `id__11`,        
X'6058' AS `rhs__12`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
3 AS `id__11`,        
X'6059' AS `rhs__12`
) AS `set_op_scan_12` ON `id__5` = `id__11`
) AS `join_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `id__5` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/pipe/join	left outer join keeps left-side row when no match
SELECT
`id__5` AS `id`,  
`lhs__6` AS `lhs`,  
`rhs__8` AS `rhs`
FROM (
SELECT  
`id__5`,    
`lhs__6`,    
`id__7`,    
`rhs__8`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id__5`,      
`lhs__6`,      
`id__7`,      
`rhs__8`    
FROM (
SELECT      
1 AS `id__5`,        
X'6061' AS `lhs__6`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
2 AS `id__5`,        
X'6062' AS `lhs__6`
) AS `set_op_scan_5` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT      
1 AS `id__7`,        
X'6058' AS `rhs__8`
) AS `project_scan_12` ON `id__5` = `id__7`
) AS `join_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `id__5` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/pipe/limit	limit caps the row count

UNION ALL

3 AS `x__5`

) AS `limit_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/pipe/where	filter integers above threshold

) AS `project_scan_4`

) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/conditional_expressions	CASE picks the first matching branch
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
CASE WHEN 1 > 0 THEN X'60706f73' WHEN 1 < 0 THEN X'606e6567' ELSE X'607a65726f' END AS `$col1__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/conditional_expressions	CASE with value form
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
CASE 2 WHEN 1 THEN X'606f6e65' WHEN 2 THEN X'6074776f' ELSE X'606f74686572' END AS `$col1__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/conditional_expressions	IF returns then-branch when condition is true
SELECT
`result__1` AS `result`
FROM (
SELECT  
CASE WHEN 1 > 0 THEN X'60706f73' ELSE X'606e6567' END AS `result__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/conditional_expressions	IFNULL replaces NULL with the default
SELECT
`result__1` AS `result`
FROM (
SELECT  
CASE WHEN null IS NULL THEN X'6064656661756c74' ELSE null END AS `result__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/conditional_expressions	COALESCE returns the first non-NULL argument
SELECT
`first_non_null__1` AS `first_non_null`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_coalesce(null, null, X'6078', X'6079') AS `first_non_null__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/conditional_expressions	NULLIF returns NULL when the arguments are equal
SELECT
`r1__1` AS `r1`,  
`r2__2` AS `r2`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_nullif(1, 1) AS `r1__1`,    
zetasqlite_nullif(1, 2) AS `r2__2`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/cube	cube over a single column equals rollup
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`k__4` AS `k`,  
`total__2` AS `total`
FROM (
SELECT  
`k__4`,    
`total__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`k__4`,      
`total__2`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`k__3` AS `k__4`,        
zetasqlite_sum(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$unnest1__1`, 1)) AS `total__2`      
FROM (
SELECT        
`$array_6`.`value` AS `$unnest1__1`,          
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0) AS `k__3`        
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e030f02016b04016101760101000000000000000f02016b04016101760102000000000000000f02016b0401620176010300000000000000') AS `$array_6`
) AS `project_scan_5`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`k__3`)      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
NULL AS `k`,        
zetasqlite_sum(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$unnest1__1`, 1)) AS `total__2`      
FROM (
SELECT        
`$array_6`.`value` AS `$unnest1__1`,          
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0) AS `k__3`        
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e030f02016b04016101760101000000000000000f02016b04016101760102000000000000000f02016b0401620176010300000000000000') AS `$array_6`
) AS `project_scan_5`      
GROUP BY NULL      
ORDER BY `k__3` ASC
) AS `set_op_scan_inner`
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `k__4` IS NOT NULL DESC, `k__4` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/group_by	scalar GROUP BY with COUNT
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`k__4` AS `k`,  
`n__2` AS `n`
FROM (
SELECT  
`k__4`,    
`n__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`k__3` AS `k__4`,      
zetasqlite_count_star() AS `n__2`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`$array_6`.`value` AS `$unnest1__1`,        
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0) AS `k__3`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e030f01016b0401610f01016b0401610f01016b040162') AS `$array_6`
) AS `project_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`k__3`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `k__4` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/group_by	GROUP BY on individual STRUCT fields
SELECT
`x__5` AS `gx`,  
`y__6` AS `gy`,  
`n__2` AS `n`
FROM (
SELECT  
`x__5`,    
`y__6`,    
`n__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`gx__3` AS `x__5`,      
`gy__4` AS `y__6`,      
zetasqlite_count_star() AS `n__2`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`$array_6`.`value` AS `s__1`,        
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0) AS `gx__3`,        
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 1) AS `gy__4`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e030f02017801010000000000000001790401610f02017801010000000000000001790401610f0201780102000000000000000179040162') AS `$array_6`
) AS `project_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`gx__3`), zetasqlite_group_by(`gy__4`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `x__5` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/group_by	NULL becomes its own GROUP BY bucket
SELECT
`k__4` AS `k`,  
`n__2` AS `n`
FROM (
SELECT  
`k__4`,    
`n__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`k__3` AS `k__4`,      
zetasqlite_count_star() AS `n__2`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`$array_6`.`value` AS `$unnest1__1`,        
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0) AS `k__3`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e040f01016b0101000000000000000f01016b000f01016b0101000000000000000f01016b00') AS `$array_6`
) AS `project_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`k__3`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `k__4` IS NOT NULL DESC, `k__4` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/group_by	GROUP BY a scalar column that carries an ARRAY field in the row

### googlesql/syntax/query/grouping_sets	per-key total plus grand total via GROUPING SETS
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`k__4` AS `k`,  
`total__2` AS `total`
FROM (

`k__4`,    
`total__2`  
FROM (

`k__4`,      
`total__2`

FROM (
SELECT        
`$array_6`.`value` AS `$unnest1__1`,          
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0) AS `k__3`        
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e030f02016b04016101760101000000000000000f02016b04016101760102000000000000000f02016b0401620176010300000000000000') AS `$array_6`
) AS `project_scan_5`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`k__3`)      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
NULL AS `k`,        
zetasqlite_sum(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$unnest1__1`, 1)) AS `total__2`      
FROM (
SELECT        
`$array_6`.`value` AS `$unnest1__1`,          
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0) AS `k__3`

) AS `project_scan_5`      
GROUP BY NULL      
ORDER BY `k__3` ASC
) AS `set_op_scan_inner`
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `k__4` IS NOT NULL DESC, `k__4` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/join	INNER JOIN on equality
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`a__1` AS `a`,  
`b__2` AS `b`
FROM (
SELECT  
`a__1`,    
`b__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`array_scan_5`.`a__1`,      
`$array_4`.`value` AS `b__2`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`$array_5`.`value` AS `a__1`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000') AS `$array_5`
) AS `array_scan_5` INNER JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e03010200000000000000010300000000000000010400000000000000') AS `$array_4` ON `array_scan_5`.`a__1` = `$array_4`.`value`
) AS `array_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `a__1` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/join	LEFT JOIN keeps unmatched left-side row
SELECT
`a__1` AS `a`,  
`b__2` AS `b`
FROM (
SELECT  
`a__1`,    
`b__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`array_scan_5`.`a__1`,      
`$array_4`.`value` AS `b__2`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`$array_5`.`value` AS `a__1`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e02010100000000000000010200000000000000') AS `$array_5`
) AS `array_scan_5` LEFT JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e01010200000000000000') AS `$array_4` ON `array_scan_5`.`a__1` = `$array_4`.`value`
) AS `array_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `a__1` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/join	CROSS JOIN produces the Cartesian product
SELECT
`a__1` AS `a`,  
`b__2` AS `b`
FROM (
SELECT  
`a__1`,    
`b__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`array_scan_5`.`a__1`,      
`$array_4`.`value` AS `b__2`

`$array_5`.`value` AS `a__1`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e02010100000000000000010200000000000000') AS `$array_5`
) AS `array_scan_5` CROSS JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e02010300000000000000010400000000000000') AS `$array_4`
) AS `array_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `a__1` ASC, `b__2` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/join	FULL OUTER JOIN keeps unmatched rows from both sides
SELECT
`a__1` AS `a`,  
`b__2` AS `b`
FROM (
SELECT  
`a__1`,    
`b__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`a__1`,      
`b__2`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`$array_5`.`value` AS `a__1`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e02010100000000000000010200000000000000') AS `$array_5`
) AS `array_scan_5` FULL OUTER JOIN (
SELECT      
`$array_6`.`value` AS `b__2`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e02010200000000000000010300000000000000') AS `$array_6`
) AS `array_scan_6` ON `a__1` = `b__2`
) AS `join_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `a__1` IS NOT NULL DESC, `a__1` ASC, `b__2` IS NOT NULL DESC, `b__2` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/qualify	top-1 per partition via QUALIFY
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`k__5` AS `k`,  
`v__6` AS `v`
FROM (
SELECT  
`k__5`,    
`v__6`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`$unnest1__1`,      
`k__5`,      
`v__6`,      
`$analytic1__7`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`$unnest1__1`,        
`k__5`,        
`v__6`,        
zetasqlite_window_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY `k__5` ORDER BY `v__6` DESC GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE TIES) AS `$analytic1__7`      
FROM (
SELECT        
`$array_7`.`value` AS `$unnest1__1`,          
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_7`.`value`, 0) AS `k__5`,          
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_7`.`value`, 1) AS `v__6`        
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e040f02016b04016101760101000000000000000f02016b04016101760102000000000000000f02016b04016201760103000000000000000f02016b0401620176010000000000000000') AS `$array_7`
) AS `project_scan_6`      
ORDER BY `k__5` ASC, `v__6` DESC
) AS `analytic_scan_5`    
WHERE `$analytic1__7` = 1
) AS `filter_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `k__5` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/unnest	LEFT JOIN against an empty array preserves the outer row

X'6078' AS `a__1`
) AS `project_scan_5` LEFT JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e00') AS `$array_4` ON true;

### googlesql/syntax/query/unnest	LEFT JOIN against a non-empty array fans the outer row
SELECT
`a__1` AS `a`,  
`v__2` AS `v`
FROM (
SELECT  
`a__1`,    
`v__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`project_scan_5`.`a__1`,      
`$array_4`.`value` AS `v__2`    
FROM (
SELECT      
X'6078' AS `a__1`
) AS `project_scan_5` LEFT JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000') AS `$array_4` ON true
) AS `array_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `v__2` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/unnest	correlated UNNEST — inner UNNEST references outer column
SELECT
`x__3` AS `x`,  
`v__2` AS `v`
FROM (
SELECT  
`x__3`,    
`v__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`s__1`,      
`v__2`,      
`x__3`,      
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`s__1`, 0) AS `$orderbycol1__4`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`array_scan_7`.`s__1`,        
`$array_6`.`value` AS `v__2`,        
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`array_scan_7`.`s__1`, 0) AS `x__3`      
FROM (
SELECT        
`$array_7`.`value` AS `s__1`        
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e020f020178010100000000000000036172720e02010a000000000000000114000000000000000f020178010200000000000000036172720e01011e00000000000000') AS `$array_7`
) AS `array_scan_7` CROSS JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`s__1`, 1)) AS `$array_6`
) AS `project_scan_5`
) AS `project_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `$orderbycol1__4` ASC, `v__2` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/unpivot	unpivot two columns into value/column-name rows
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`val__3` AS `val`,  
`col__4` AS `col`
FROM (
SELECT  
`val__3`,    
`col__4`  
FROM (
SELECT    
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0) AS `val__3`,      
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 1) AS `col__4`    
FROM (
SELECT      
1 AS `a__1`,        
2 AS `b__2`
) AS `project_scan_7` CROSS JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(zetasqlite_make_array(zetasqlite_make_struct(X'6076616c', `a__1`, X'60636f6c', X'6061'), zetasqlite_make_struct(X'6076616c', `b__2`, X'60636f6c', X'6062'))) AS `$array_6`    
WHERE zetasqlite_not(zetasqlite_is_null(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0)))
) AS `project_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `col__4` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/window_clause	named window via WINDOW clause
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`x__1` AS `x`,  
`running__3` AS `running`
FROM (
SELECT  
`x__1`,    
`running__3`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`x__1`,      
zetasqlite_window_sum(`x__1`) OVER (ORDER BY `x__1` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `running__3`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`$array_5`.`value` AS `x__1`      
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000') AS `$array_5`
) AS `array_scan_5`    
ORDER BY `x__1` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `x__1` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/with_cte	single CTE referenced in the outer SELECT

`wrs8`.`y__2` AS `y`
FROM `t` AS `wrs8`;

### googlesql/syntax/query/with_cte	multiple CTEs referenced together
SELECT
`r__5` AS `r`
FROM (
WITH `t1` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `x__1`  )
,   
`t2` AS 	(  
SELECT    
2 AS `y__2`  )
  
SELECT  
zetasqlite_add(`x__3`, `y__4`) AS `r__5`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs12`.`x__1` AS `x__3`    
FROM `t1` AS `wrs12`
) AS `with_ref_scan_12` INNER JOIN (
SELECT    
`wrs13`.`y__2` AS `y__4`    
FROM `t2` AS `wrs13`
) AS `with_ref_scan_13`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

`s__4` AS `s`
FROM (

FROM (

UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'0f02016104036465660162010500000000000000' AS `s__4`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'0f02016104036465660162010500000000000000' AS `s__4`
) AS `set_op_scan_5`
) AS `project_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `$orderbycol1__5` ASC, `$orderbycol2__6` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/aggregate/any_value	any_value with window
SELECT
`fruit__1` AS `fruit`,  
`$analytic1__3` AS `$col2`
FROM (
SELECT  
`fruit__1`,    
zetasqlite_window_any_value(`fruit__1`) OVER (ORDER BY `$orderbycol1__4` ASC ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `$analytic1__3`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`$array_6`.`value` AS `fruit__1`,      
zetasqlite_length(`$array_6`.`value`) AS `$orderbycol1__4`    
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e0304056170706c65040662616e616e61040470656172') AS `$array_6`
) AS `project_scan_5`  
ORDER BY `$orderbycol1__4` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_4`;

### zigquery/functions/aggregate/any_value	any_value with having max
SELECT
`fruit__18` AS `fruit`,  
`max_sales__17` AS `max_sales`
FROM (
WITH `Store` AS 	(  
SELECT    
20 AS `sold__13`,      
X'606170706c6573' AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
10 AS `sold__13`,      
X'606170706c6573' AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
40 AS `sold__13`,      
X'607065617273' AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
10 AS `sold__13`,      
X'606f72616e676573' AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
30 AS `sold__13`,      
X'6062616e616e6173' AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
10 AS `sold__13`,      
X'6062616e616e6173' AS `fruit__14`  )
  
SELECT  
`fruit__18`,    
`max_sales__17`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs26`.`fruit__14` AS `fruit__18`,      
zetasqlite_any_value(`wrs26`.`sold__13`, zetasqlite_having_max(`wrs26`.`sold__13`)) AS `max_sales__17`    
FROM `Store` AS `wrs26`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs26`.`fruit__14`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_25`  
ORDER BY `fruit__18` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/aggregate/any_value	any_value having max and min together
SELECT

FROM (
WITH `Store` AS 	(  
SELECT    
20 AS `sold__13`,      
X'606170706c6573' AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
10 AS `sold__13`,      
X'606170706c6573' AS `fruit__14`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT

`fruit__19`,    
`least_sales__17`,

`wrs26`.`fruit__14` AS `fruit__19`,

zetasqlite_any_value(`wrs26`.`sold__13`, zetasqlite_having_max(`wrs26`.`sold__13`)) AS `most_sales__18`

) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/aggregate/any_value	any_value having max with different expression
SELECT
`name__20` AS `name`,  
`price_at_max_count__19` AS `price_at_max_count`
FROM (
WITH `Produce` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'606170706c65' AS `name__13`,      
3 AS `count__14`,      
0.5 AS `price__15`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'606170706c65' AS `name__13`,      
2 AS `count__14`,      
0.75 AS `price__15`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'6062616e616e61' AS `name__13`,      
5 AS `count__14`,      
0.25 AS `price__15`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'6062616e616e61' AS `name__13`,      
1 AS `count__14`,      
0.3 AS `price__15`  )
  
SELECT  
`name__20`,    
`price_at_max_count__19`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs20`.`name__13` AS `name__20`,      
zetasqlite_any_value(`wrs20`.`price__15`, zetasqlite_having_max(`wrs20`.`count__14`)) AS `price_at_max_count__19`    
FROM `Produce` AS `wrs20`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs20`.`name__13`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_19`  
ORDER BY `name__20` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/aggregate/max_by	max_by basic
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`fruit__16` AS `fruit`,  
`max_sales__15` AS `max_sales`
FROM (
WITH `Store` AS 	(  
SELECT    
20 AS `sold__11`,      
X'606170706c6573' AS `fruit__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
40 AS `sold__11`,      
X'607065617273' AS `fruit__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
50 AS `sold__11`,      
X'606f72616e676573' AS `fruit__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
30 AS `sold__11`,      
X'6062616e616e6173' AS `fruit__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
10 AS `sold__11`,      
X'6062616e616e6173' AS `fruit__12`  )
  
SELECT  
`fruit__16`,    
`max_sales__15`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs23`.`fruit__12` AS `fruit__16`,      
zetasqlite_any_value(`wrs23`.`sold__11`, zetasqlite_having_max(`wrs23`.`sold__11`)) AS `max_sales__15`    
FROM `Store` AS `wrs23`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs23`.`fruit__12`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_22`  
ORDER BY `fruit__16` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/aggregate/min_by	min_by basic
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`fruit__16` AS `fruit`,  
`min_sales__15` AS `min_sales`
FROM (
WITH `Store` AS 	(  
SELECT    
20 AS `sold__11`,      
X'606170706c6573' AS `fruit__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
40 AS `sold__11`,      
X'607065617273' AS `fruit__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
50 AS `sold__11`,      
X'606f72616e676573' AS `fruit__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
30 AS `sold__11`,      
X'6062616e616e6173' AS `fruit__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
10 AS `sold__11`,      
X'6062616e616e6173' AS `fruit__12`  )
  
SELECT  
`fruit__16`,    
`min_sales__15`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs23`.`fruit__12` AS `fruit__16`,      
zetasqlite_any_value(`wrs23`.`sold__11`, zetasqlite_having_min(`wrs23`.`sold__11`)) AS `min_sales__15`    
FROM `Store` AS `wrs23`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs23`.`fruit__12`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_22`  
ORDER BY `fruit__16` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/array/array	array scan left outer join
SELECT
`item__4` AS `item`,  
`item_in_stock__6` AS `item_in_stock`
FROM (
WITH `produce` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'606c657474756365' AS `item__3`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'6062616e616e61' AS `item__3`  )
  
SELECT  
`with_ref_scan_14`.`item__4`,    
zetasqlite_not(zetasqlite_is_null(`$array_13`.`value`)) AS `item_in_stock__6`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs14`.`item__3` AS `item__4`    
FROM `produce` AS `wrs14`
) AS `with_ref_scan_14` LEFT JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e0104076c657474756365') AS `$array_13` ON `$array_13`.`value` = `with_ref_scan_14`.`item__4`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/array/array_length	array length comparison
SELECT
`idx__10` AS `idx`,  
`col1__11` AS `col1`,  
`arr_col__12` AS `arr_col`
FROM (
SELECT  
1 AS `idx__10`,    
1 AS `col1__11`,    
X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000' AS `arr_col__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
2 AS `idx__10`,    
2 AS `col1__11`,    
X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000' AS `arr_col__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
3 AS `idx__10`,    
3 AS `col1__11`,    
X'0e04010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000010400000000000000' AS `arr_col__12`
) AS `set_op_scan_6` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT  
1 AS `idx__22`,    
1 AS `col1__23`,    
X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000' AS `arr_col__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
3 AS `idx__22`,    
3 AS `col1__23`,    
X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000' AS `arr_col__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
4 AS `idx__22`,    
4 AS `col1__23`,    
X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000' AS `arr_col__24`
) AS `set_op_scan_16` ON `idx__10` = `idx__22`
WHERE zetasqlite_not_equal(zetasqlite_array_length(`arr_col__12`), zetasqlite_array_length(`arr_col__24`));

### zigquery/functions/array/array_slice	array_slice basic
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
(SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_or(zetasqlite_is_null(X'0e05040161040162040163040164040165'), zetasqlite_is_null(1), zetasqlite_is_null(3)) THEN null WHEN zetasqlite_equal(zetasqlite_array_length(X'0e05040161040162040163040164040165'), 0) THEN X'0e00' ELSE (SELECT      
(SELECT        
zetasqlite_array(`e__7`)        
FROM (
SELECT          
`e__7`          
FROM (
SELECT            
`$array_14`.`value` AS `e__7`,              
`$array_14`.`key` AS `idx__8`            
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e05040161040162040163040164040165') AS `$array_14`            
WHERE zetasqlite_between(`$array_14`.`key`, `start_offset__5`, `end_offset__6`)
) AS `filter_scan_13`          
ORDER BY `idx__8` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_12`) AS `injected__10`      
FROM (
SELECT        
`start_offset__5`,          
CASE WHEN 3 < 0 THEN zetasqlite_add(3, zetasqlite_array_length(X'0e05040161040162040163040164040165')) ELSE 3 END AS `end_offset__6`        
FROM (
SELECT          
CASE WHEN 1 < 0 THEN zetasqlite_add(1, zetasqlite_array_length(X'0e05040161040162040163040164040165')) ELSE 1 END AS `start_offset__5`
) AS `project_scan_10`
) AS `project_scan_9`) END AS `$col1__9`) AS `$col1__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/date/extract	extract date
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`date__1` AS `date`,  
`$col2__2` AS `$col2`,  
`$col3__3` AS `$col3`,  
`$col4__4` AS `$col4`,  
`$col5__5` AS `$col5`,  
`$col6__6` AS `$col6`,  
`$col7__7` AS `$col7`
FROM (
SELECT  
`$array_4`.`value` AS `date__1`,    
zetasqlite_extract(`$array_4`.`value`, X'6049534f59454152') AS `$col2__2`,    
zetasqlite_extract(`$array_4`.`value`, X'6059454152') AS `$col3__3`,    
zetasqlite_extract(`$array_4`.`value`, X'604d4f4e5448') AS `$col4__4`,    
zetasqlite_extract(`$array_4`.`value`, X'6049534f5745454b') AS `$col5__5`,    
zetasqlite_extract(`$array_4`.`value`, X'605745454b') AS `$col6__6`,    
zetasqlite_extract(`$array_4`.`value`, X'60444159') AS `$col7__7`  
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e01099841000000000000') AS `$array_4`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/date/format_date	format_date %U counts weeks from the year's first Sunday
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`,  
`$col2__2` AS `$col2`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_format_date(X'602555', X'408000000000004b9e') AS `$col1__1`,

) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/date/format_date	format_date %W counts weeks from the year's first Monday
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`,  
`$col2__2` AS `$col2`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_format_date(X'602557', X'408000000000004b9e') AS `$col1__1`,    
zetasqlite_format_date(X'602557', X'408000000000004e77') AS `$col2__2`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/date/format_date	format_date %V is the ISO week, which disagrees with %U and %W at New Year
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`,  
`$col2__2` AS `$col2`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_format_date(X'602556', X'408000000000004b9e') AS `$col1__1`,    
zetasqlite_format_date(X'602556', X'408000000000004e77') AS `$col2__2`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/date/format_date	format_date %G and %g are the ISO year, not the calendar year
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`,  
`$col2__2` AS `$col2`,  
`$col3__3` AS `$col3`,  
`$col4__4` AS `$col4`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_format_date(X'602547', X'408000000000004b9e') AS `$col1__1`,    
zetasqlite_format_date(X'602567', X'408000000000004b9e') AS `$col2__2`,    
zetasqlite_format_date(X'602547', X'408000000000004e77') AS `$col3__3`,    
zetasqlite_format_date(X'602567', X'408000000000004e77') AS `$col4__4`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/date/format_date	format_date %u is the weekday Monday=1..7, not a week number
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`,  
`$col2__2` AS `$col2`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_format_date(X'602575', X'408000000000004b9e') AS `$col1__1`,

### zigquery/functions/datetime/datetime_diff	datetime_diff with week day (case 463)
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`,  
`$col2__2` AS `$col2`,  
`$col3__3` AS `$col3`,  
`$col4__4` AS `$col4`,  
`$col5__5` AS `$col5`,  
`$col6__6` AS `$col6`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_datetime_diff(X'50800613f827c06000', X'508006145cbcf54000', X'605745454b') AS `$col1__1`,    
zetasqlite_datetime_diff(X'50800613f827c06000', X'508006145cbcf54000', X'605745454b5f4d4f4e444159') AS `$col2__2`,    
zetasqlite_datetime_diff(X'5080061470dacca000', X'50800613f827c06000', X'605745454b') AS `$col3__3`,    
zetasqlite_datetime_diff(X'50800613f827c06000', X'5080061470dacca000', X'605745454b5f4d4f4e444159') AS `$col4__4`,    
zetasqlite_datetime_diff(X'50800613f827c06000', X'5080055c53bc9d0000', X'605745454b5f4d4f4e444159') AS `$col5__5`,    
zetasqlite_datetime_diff(X'50800611d902094000', X'5080061279f0c44000', X'605745454b5f4d4f4e444159') AS `$col6__6`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/datetime/datetime_diff	datetime_diff with week day 1 week
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`

### zigquery/functions/debug/error	error
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`new_value__5` AS `new_value`
FROM (
SELECT  
CASE WHEN `value__4` = X'60666f6f' THEN X'6056616c756520697320666f6f2e' WHEN `value__4` = X'60626172' THEN X'6056616c7565206973206261722e' ELSE zetasqlite_cast(zetasqlite_error(zetasqlite_concat(X'60466f756e6420756e65787065637465642076616c75653a20', `value__4`)), X'607b226e616d65223a22222c226b696e64223a382c227369676e61747572654b696e64223a302c22656c656d656e7454797065223a6e756c6c2c226669656c645479706573223a6e756c6c7d', X'607b226e616d65223a22222c226b696e64223a382c227369676e61747572654b696e64223a302c22656c656d656e7454797065223a6e756c6c2c226669656c645479706573223a6e756c6c7d', false) END AS `new_value__5`  
FROM (
SELECT    
X'60666f6f' AS `value__4`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'60626172' AS `value__4`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'6062617a' AS `value__4`
) AS `set_op_scan_4`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/hash/farm_fingerprint	farm_fingerprint
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`x__13` AS `x`,  
`y__14` AS `y`,  
`z__15` AS `z`,  
`$col2__16` AS `$col2`
FROM (
WITH `example` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `x__10`,      
X'60666f6f' AS `y__11`,      
true AS `z__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
2 AS `x__10`,      
X'606170706c65' AS `y__11`,      
false AS `z__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
3 AS `x__10`,      
X'60' AS `y__11`,      
true AS `z__12`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs16`.`x__10` AS `x__13`,    
`wrs16`.`y__11` AS `y__14`,    
`wrs16`.`z__12` AS `z__15`,    
zetasqlite_farm_fingerprint(zetasqlite_concat(zetasqlite_cast(`wrs16`.`x__10`, X'607b226e616d65223a22222c226b696e64223a322c227369676e61747572654b696e64223a302c22656c656d656e7454797065223a6e756c6c2c226669656c645479706573223a6e756c6c7d', X'607b226e616d65223a22222c226b696e64223a382c227369676e61747572654b696e64223a302c22656c656d656e7454797065223a6e756c6c2c226669656c645479706573223a6e756c6c7d', false), `wrs16`.`y__11`, zetasqlite_cast(`wrs16`.`z__12`, X'607b226e616d65223a22222c226b696e64223a352c227369676e61747572654b696e64223a302c22656c656d656e7454797065223a6e756c6c2c226669656c645479706573223a6e756c6c7d', X'607b226e616d65223a22222c226b696e64223a382c227369676e61747572654b696e64223a302c22656c656d656e7454797065223a6e756c6c2c226669656c645479706573223a6e756c6c7d', false))) AS `$col2__16`  
FROM `example` AS `wrs16`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/hll/hll_count_extract	hll_count.extract
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`country__3` AS `country`,  
`distinct_customers_with_open_invoice__4` AS `distinct_customers_with_open_invoice`
FROM (
SELECT  
`country__3`,    
zetasqlite_hll_count_extract(`hll_sketch__2`) AS `distinct_customers_with_open_invoice__4`  
FROM (
SELECT    
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0) AS `country__3`,      
zetasqlite_hll_count_init(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 1)) AS `hll_sketch__2`    
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'') AS `$array_6`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_6`.`value`, 0))
) AS `aggregate_scan_5`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/net/net_host	net_host
PRAGMA user_version;

FROM (
SELECT    
X'60' AS `url__9`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'60687474703a2f2f6162632e78797a' AS `url__9`    
UNION ALL

UNION ALL

### zigquery/functions/string/contains_substr	contains_substr for table all rows
WITH `Recipes` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'60426c756562657272792070616e63616b6573' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'604567672073616c61642073616e6477696368' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'60506f7461746f2064756d706c696e6773' AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60506f7461746f2070616e63616b6573' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'60546f6173746564206368656573652073616e6477696368' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'6042656566207374726f67616e6f6666' AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6048616d20736372616d626c65' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'60537465616b2061766f6361646f2073616c6164' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'60546f6d61746f207061737461' AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6041766f6361646f20746f617374' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'60546f6d61746f20736f7570' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'60426c756562657272792073616c6d6f6e' AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60436f726e656420626565662068617368' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'604c656e74696c20706f7461746f20736f7570' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'60476c617a65642068616d' AS `Dinner__18`)

SELECT
`wrs23`.`Breakfast__16` AS `Breakfast`,  
`wrs23`.`Lunch__17` AS `Lunch`,  
`wrs23`.`Dinner__18` AS `Dinner`
FROM `Recipes` AS `wrs23`
WHERE zetasqlite_contains_substr(zetasqlite_make_struct(X'60427265616b66617374', `wrs23`.`Breakfast__16`, X'604c756e6368', `wrs23`.`Lunch__17`, X'6044696e6e6572', `wrs23`.`Dinner__18`), X'60746f617374');

`wrs23`.`Breakfast__16` AS `Breakfast`,  
`wrs23`.`Lunch__17` AS `Lunch`,  
`wrs23`.`Dinner__18` AS `Dinner`
FROM `Recipes` AS `wrs23`
WHERE zetasqlite_contains_substr(zetasqlite_make_struct(X'60', `wrs23`.`Lunch__17`, X'60', `wrs23`.`Dinner__18`), X'60706f7461746f');

### zigquery/functions/string/contains_substr	contains_substr for table except
WITH `Recipes` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'60426c756562657272792070616e63616b6573' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'604567672073616c61642073616e6477696368' AS `Lunch__17`,

UNION ALL

X'60546f6173746564206368656573652073616e6477696368' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'6042656566207374726f67616e6f6666' AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6048616d20736372616d626c65' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'60537465616b2061766f6361646f2073616c6164' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'60546f6d61746f207061737461' AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6041766f6361646f20746f617374' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'60546f6d61746f20736f7570' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'60426c756562657272792073616c6d6f6e' AS `Dinner__18`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60436f726e656420626565662068617368' AS `Breakfast__16`,    
X'604c656e74696c20706f7461746f20736f7570' AS `Lunch__17`,    
X'60476c617a65642068616d' AS `Dinner__18`)

### zigquery/functions/string/normalize	normalize with nfkc
WITH `EquivalentNames` AS 	(
SELECT  
`$array_6`.`value` AS `name__1`  
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e05040a4a616e65e28084446f65040c4a6f686ee28084536d697468040a4a616e65e28085446f65040a4a616e65e28086446f65040a4a6f686e20536d697468') AS `$array_6`)

FROM (

zetasqlite_count_star() AS `name_count__3`  
FROM `EquivalentNames` AS `wrs9`  
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(zetasqlite_normalize(`wrs9`.`name__1`, X'604e464b43'))
) AS `aggregate_scan_8`;

### zigquery/functions/string/normalize_and_casefold	normalize_and_casefold

`$col2__2` AS `$col2`,  
`$col3__3` AS `$col3`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_to_hex(X'6800010203aaeeefff') AS `$col1__1`,    
zetasqlite_to_hex(X'68666f6f626172') AS `$col2__2`,    
zetasqlite_to_hex(null) AS `$col3__3`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/string/translate	translate
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`expression__22` AS `expression`,  
`source_characters__23` AS `source_characters`,  
`target_characters__24` AS `target_characters`,  
`$col4__25` AS `$col4`
FROM (
WITH `example` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'6054686973206973206120636f6f6b6965' AS `expression__16`,      
X'6073636f' AS `source_characters__17`,      
X'607a6b75' AS `target_characters__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604120636f6173746572' AS `expression__16`,      
X'60636f' AS `source_characters__17`,      
X'606b' AS `target_characters__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
null AS `expression__16`,      
X'60636f' AS `source_characters__17`,      
X'606b' AS `target_characters__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604120636f6173746572' AS `expression__16`,      
null AS `source_characters__17`,      
X'606b' AS `target_characters__18`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604120636f6173746572' AS `expression__16`,      
X'60636f' AS `source_characters__17`,      
null AS `target_characters__18`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs25`.`expression__16` AS `expression__22`,    
`wrs25`.`source_characters__17` AS `source_characters__23`,    
`wrs25`.`target_characters__18` AS `target_characters__24`,    
zetasqlite_translate(`wrs25`.`expression__16`, `wrs25`.`source_characters__17`, `wrs25`.`target_characters__18`) AS `$col4__25`  
FROM `example` AS `wrs25`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/string/translate	translate unicode source and target
SELECT
`got__1` AS `got`,  
`expected__2` AS `expected`,  
`pass__3` AS `pass`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_translate(X'60c398c3b8c390c3b0c490c491c581c582c4b1c58ac58b', zetasqlite_concat(zetasqlite_chr(216), zetasqlite_chr(248), zetasqlite_chr(208), zetasqlite_chr(240), zetasqlite_chr(272), zetasqlite_chr(273), zetasqlite_chr(321), zetasqlite_chr(322), zetasqlite_chr(305), zetasqlite_chr(330), zetasqlite_chr(331)), X'604f6f446444644c6c694e6e') AS `got__1`,    
X'604f6f446444644c6c694e6e' AS `expected__2`,    
zetasqlite_equal(zetasqlite_translate(X'60c398c3b8c390c3b0c490c491c581c582c4b1c58ac58b', zetasqlite_concat(zetasqlite_chr(216), zetasqlite_chr(248), zetasqlite_chr(208), zetasqlite_chr(240), zetasqlite_chr(272), zetasqlite_chr(273), zetasqlite_chr(321), zetasqlite_chr(322), zetasqlite_chr(305), zetasqlite_chr(330), zetasqlite_chr(331)), X'604f6f446444644c6c694e6e'), X'604f6f446444644c6c694e6e') AS `pass__3`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/timestamp/extract	extract from timestamp
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`$col1__3` AS `$col1`,  
`$col2__4` AS `$col2`,  
`$col3__5` AS `$col3`
FROM (
WITH `Input` AS 	(  
SELECT    
zetasqlite_timestamp(X'60323030382d31322d32352030353a33303a30302b3030') AS `timestamp_value__1`  )
  
SELECT  
zetasqlite_extract(`wrs8`.`timestamp_value__1`, X'60444159', X'60555443') AS `$col1__3`,    
zetasqlite_extract(`wrs8`.`timestamp_value__1`, X'60444159', X'60416d65726963612f4c6f735f416e67656c6573') AS `$col2__4`,    
zetasqlite_extract_date(`wrs8`.`timestamp_value__1`) AS `$col3__5`  
FROM `Input` AS `wrs8`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/timestamp/format_timestamp	format_timestamp %z is the offset as +HHMM, %Ez as +HH:MM
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`,  
`$col2__2` AS `$col2`,  
`$col3__3` AS `$col3`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'60257a7c25457a', X'58800613a7b062e000') AS `$col1__1`,    
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'60257a7c25457a', X'58800613a7b062e000', X'60417369612f546f6b796f') AS `$col2__2`,

FROM `tmp` AS `wrs8`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/timestamp/timestamp_bucket	timestamp_bucket buckets from the default 1950-01-01 origin
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`$col1__7` AS `$col1`
FROM (
WITH `some_timestamps` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'587ffdc1db230e3400' AS `my_timestamp__5`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'587ffdc1e45b664000' AS `my_timestamp__5`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'587ffdc1f8793da000' AS `my_timestamp__5`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'587ffdc2035ebcf400' AS `my_timestamp__5`  )
  
SELECT  
`$col1__7`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs20`.`my_timestamp__5` AS `my_timestamp__6`,      
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'6025592d256d2d25642025483a254d3a2553', zetasqlite_timestamp_bucket(`wrs20`.`my_timestamp__5`, zetasqlite_interval(12, X'60484f5552'))) AS `$col1__7`    
FROM `some_timestamps` AS `wrs20`
) AS `project_scan_19`  
ORDER BY `my_timestamp__6` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/timestamp/timestamp_bucket	timestamp_bucket takes an explicit origin as its third argument
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'6025592d256d2d25642025483a254d3a2553', zetasqlite_timestamp_bucket(X'5880060de19bfb3c00', zetasqlite_interval(1, X'60484f5552'), X'588000000035a4e900')) AS `$col1__1`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/timestamp/timestamp_trunc	timestamp_trunc keeps the unit it is asked for
SELECT
`$col1__1` AS `$col1`,  
`$col2__2` AS `$col2`,  
`$col3__3` AS `$col3`,  
`$col4__4` AS `$col4`,  
`$col5__5` AS `$col5`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'6025483a254d3a25452a53', zetasqlite_timestamp_trunc(X'58800613b05b7979c0', X'604d4943524f5345434f4e44')) AS `$col1__1`,    
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'6025483a254d3a25452a53', zetasqlite_timestamp_trunc(X'58800613b05b7979c0', X'604d494c4c495345434f4e44')) AS `$col2__2`,    
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'6025483a254d3a25452a53', zetasqlite_timestamp_trunc(X'58800613b05b7979c0', X'605345434f4e44')) AS `$col3__3`,    
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'6025483a254d3a25452a53', zetasqlite_timestamp_trunc(X'58800613b05b7979c0', X'604d494e555445')) AS `$col4__4`,    
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'6025483a254d3a25452a53', zetasqlite_timestamp_trunc(X'58800613b05b7979c0', X'60484f5552')) AS `$col5__5`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/functions/window/cume_dist	cume_dist
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
WITH `finishers` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'60536f70686961204c6975' AS `name__25`,    
X'5880053f1ac5df5240' AS `finish_time__26`,    
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__27`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604c697361205374656c7a6e6572' AS `name__25`,    
X'5880053f1ace931ac0' AS `finish_time__26`,    
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__27`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604e696b6b69204c65697468' AS `name__25`,    
X'5880053f1adfdc2740' AS `finish_time__26`,    
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__27`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604c617572656e204d61747468657773' AS `name__25`,    
X'5880053f1ae7f75940' AS `finish_time__26`,    
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__27`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6044657369726565204265727279' AS `name__25`,    
X'5880053f1af7c2ed80' AS `finish_time__26`,    
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__27`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6053757a7920536c616e65' AS `name__25`,    
X'5880053f1afa43cc00' AS `finish_time__26`,    
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__27`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604a656e2045647761726473' AS `name__25`,    
X'5880053f1afafae700' AS `finish_time__26`,    
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__27`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604d656768616e204c656465726572' AS `name__25`,    
X'5880053f1adfdc2740' AS `finish_time__26`,    
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__27`)

SELECT
`name__28` AS `name`,  
`finish_time__32` AS `finish_time`,  
`division__30` AS `division`,  
`finish_rank__33` AS `finish_rank`
FROM (
SELECT  
`name__28`,    
`finish_time__29`,    
`division__30`,    
`finish_time__32`,    
zetasqlite_window_cume_dist() OVER (PARTITION BY `division__30` ORDER BY `finish_time__29` ASC GROUPS BETWEEN 1 FOLLOWING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `finish_rank__33`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs33`.`name__25` AS `name__28`,      
`wrs33`.`finish_time__26` AS `finish_time__29`,      
`wrs33`.`division__27` AS `division__30`,      
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'602558', `wrs33`.`finish_time__26`) AS `finish_time__32`    
FROM `finishers` AS `wrs33`
) AS `project_scan_32`  
ORDER BY `division__30` ASC, `finish_time__29` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_31`;

### zigquery/functions/window/dense_rank	window dense_rank
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
WITH `Numbers` AS 	(
SELECT  
1 AS `x__8`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
2 AS `x__8`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
2 AS `x__8`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
5 AS `x__8`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
8 AS `x__8`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
10 AS `x__8`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
10 AS `x__8`)

SELECT
`x__9` AS `x`,  
`dense_rank__11` AS `dense_rank`
FROM (
SELECT  
`x__9`,    
zetasqlite_window_dense_rank() OVER (ORDER BY `x__9` ASC RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `dense_rank__11`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs29`.`x__8` AS `x__9`    
FROM `Numbers` AS `wrs29`
) AS `with_ref_scan_29`  
ORDER BY `x__9` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_28`;
