### zigquery/functions/window/first_value	window first_value
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
WITH `Produce` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'606b616c65' AS `item__19`,    
23 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6062616e616e61' AS `item__19`,    
2 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'606672756974' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6063616262616765' AS `item__19`,    
9 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606170706c65' AS `item__19`,    
8 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'606672756974' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606c65656b' AS `item__19`,    
2 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606c657474756365' AS `item__19`,    
10 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`)

SELECT
`item__22` AS `item`,  
`purchases__23` AS `purchases`,  
`category__24` AS `category`,  
`most_popular__26` AS `most_popular`
FROM (
SELECT  
`item__22`,    
`purchases__23`,    
`category__24`,    
zetasqlite_window_first_value(`item__22`) OVER (PARTITION BY `category__24` ORDER BY `purchases__23` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `most_popular__26`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs26`.`item__19` AS `item__22`,      
`wrs26`.`purchases__20` AS `purchases__23`,      
`wrs26`.`category__21` AS `category__24`    
FROM `Produce` AS `wrs26`
) AS `with_ref_scan_26`  
ORDER BY `category__24` ASC, `purchases__23` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_25`;

### zigquery/functions/window/lag	lag with option
WITH `segments` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'60323032302d30382d3031' AS `created_at__5`,    
10 AS `rank__6`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60323032302d30382d3031' AS `created_at__5`,    
20 AS `rank__6`)

SELECT
`$analytic1__10` AS `$col1`
FROM (
SELECT  
`created_at__7`,    
`rank__8`,    
zetasqlite_window_lag(zetasqlite_add(`rank__8`, 1), 1, 0) OVER (PARTITION BY `created_at__7` ORDER BY `rank__8` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `$analytic1__10`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs14`.`created_at__5` AS `created_at__7`,      
`wrs14`.`rank__6` AS `rank__8`    
FROM `segments` AS `wrs14`
) AS `with_ref_scan_14`  
ORDER BY `created_at__7` ASC, `rank__8` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_13`;

UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606c657474756365' AS `item__19`,    
10 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`)

SELECT
`item__22` AS `item`,  
`purchases__23` AS `purchases`,  
`category__24` AS `category`,  
`most_popular__26` AS `most_popular`
FROM (

`item__22`,    
`purchases__23`,    
`category__24`,    
zetasqlite_window_last_value(`item__22`) OVER (PARTITION BY `category__24` ORDER BY `purchases__23` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `most_popular__26`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs26`.`item__19` AS `item__22`,      
`wrs26`.`purchases__20` AS `purchases__23`,      
`wrs26`.`category__21` AS `category__24`    
FROM `Produce` AS `wrs26`
) AS `with_ref_scan_26`  
ORDER BY `category__24` ASC, `purchases__23` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_25`;

### zigquery/functions/window/nth_value	nth_value
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`name__34` AS `name`,  
`finish_time__44` AS `finish_time`,  
`division__36` AS `division`,  
`fastest_time__45` AS `fastest_time`,  
`second_fastest__46` AS `second_fastest`
FROM (
WITH `finishers` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'60536f70686961204c6975' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1ac5df5240' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604c697361205374656c7a6e6572' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1ace931ac0' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604e696b6b69204c65697468' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1adfdc2740' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604c617572656e204d61747468657773' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1ae7f75940' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'6044657369726565204265727279' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1af7c2ed80' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'6053757a7920536c616e65' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1afa43cc00' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604a656e2045647761726473' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1afafae700' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604d656768616e204c656465726572' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1afedab940' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604361726c7920466f727465' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1b0371a680' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604632352d3239' AS `division__33`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'604c617572656e20526561736f6e6572' AS `name__31`,      
X'5880053f1b07f95180' AS `finish_time__32`,      
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__33`  )
  
SELECT  
`name__34`,    
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'602558', `finish_time__35`) AS `finish_time__44`,    
`division__36`,    
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'602558', `fastest_time__42`) AS `fastest_time__45`,    
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'602558', `second_fastest__43`) AS `second_fastest__46`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`name__34`,      
`finish_time__35`,      
`division__36`,      
`finishers__41`,      
zetasqlite_window_first_value(`finish_time__35`) OVER (PARTITION BY `division__36` ORDER BY `finish_time__35` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `fastest_time__42`,      
zetasqlite_window_nth_value(`finish_time__35`, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY `division__36` ORDER BY `finish_time__35` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `second_fastest__43`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`wrs40`.`name__31` AS `name__34`,        
`wrs40`.`finish_time__32` AS `finish_time__35`,        
`wrs40`.`division__33` AS `division__36`,        
zetasqlite_make_struct(X'606e616d65', `wrs40`.`name__31`, X'6066696e6973685f74696d65', `wrs40`.`finish_time__32`, X'606469766973696f6e', `wrs40`.`division__33`) AS `finishers__41`      
FROM `finishers` AS `wrs40`
) AS `project_scan_39`    
ORDER BY `division__36` ASC, `finish_time__35` ASC, `division__36` ASC, `finish_time__35` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_38`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

X'5880053f1af7c2ed80' AS `finish_time__26`,    
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__27`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6053757a7920536c616e65' AS `name__25`,    
X'5880053f1afa43cc00' AS `finish_time__26`,    
X'604633352d3339' AS `division__27`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604a656e2045647761726473' AS `name__25`,    
X'5880053f1afafae700' AS `finish_time__26`,    
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__27`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604d656768616e204c656465726572' AS `name__25`,    
X'5880053f1adfdc2740' AS `finish_time__26`,    
X'604633302d3334' AS `division__27`)

SELECT
`name__28` AS `name`,  
`finish_time__32` AS `finish_time`,  
`division__30` AS `division`,  
`finish_rank__33` AS `finish_rank`
FROM (
SELECT  
`name__28`,    
`finish_time__29`,    
`division__30`,    
`finish_time__32`,    
zetasqlite_window_percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY `division__30` ORDER BY `finish_time__29` ASC GROUPS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `finish_rank__33`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs33`.`name__25` AS `name__28`,      
`wrs33`.`finish_time__26` AS `finish_time__29`,      
`wrs33`.`division__27` AS `division__30`,      
zetasqlite_format_timestamp(X'602558', `wrs33`.`finish_time__26`) AS `finish_time__32`    
FROM `finishers` AS `wrs33`
) AS `project_scan_32`  
ORDER BY `division__30` ASC, `finish_time__29` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_31`;

FROM (
SELECT    
`$array_5`.`value` AS `x__1`

) AS `array_scan_5`
) AS `analytic_scan_4`;

### zigquery/functions/window/rank	window rank
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
WITH `Employees` AS 	(
SELECT  
`name__1` AS `name__19`,    
`department__2` AS `department__20`,    
`start_date__3` AS `start_date__21`  
FROM (
SELECT    
X'6049736162656c6c61' AS `name__1`,      
2 AS `department__2`,      
zetasqlite_date(1997, 9, 28) AS `start_date__3`
) AS `project_scan_7`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`$col1__4` AS `name__19`,    
`$col2__5` AS `department__20`,    
`$col3__6` AS `start_date__21`  
FROM (
SELECT    
X'60416e74686f6e79' AS `$col1__4`,      
1 AS `$col2__5`,      
zetasqlite_date(1995, 11, 29) AS `$col3__6`
) AS `project_scan_10`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`$col1__7` AS `name__19`,    
`$col2__8` AS `department__20`,    
`$col3__9` AS `start_date__21`  
FROM (
SELECT    
X'6044616e69656c' AS `$col1__7`,      
2 AS `$col2__8`,      
zetasqlite_date(2004, 6, 24) AS `$col3__9`
) AS `project_scan_13`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`$col1__10` AS `name__19`,    
`$col2__11` AS `department__20`,    
`$col3__12` AS `start_date__21`  
FROM (
SELECT    
X'60416e64726577' AS `$col1__10`,      
1 AS `$col2__11`,      
zetasqlite_date(1999, 1, 23) AS `$col3__12`
) AS `project_scan_16`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`$col1__13` AS `name__19`,    
`$col2__14` AS `department__20`,    
`$col3__15` AS `start_date__21`  
FROM (
SELECT    
X'604a61636f62' AS `$col1__13`,      
1 AS `$col2__14`,      
zetasqlite_date(1990, 7, 11) AS `$col3__15`
) AS `project_scan_19`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`$col1__16` AS `name__19`,    
`$col2__17` AS `department__20`,    
`$col3__18` AS `start_date__21`  
FROM (
SELECT    
X'604a6f7365' AS `$col1__16`,      
2 AS `$col2__17`,      
zetasqlite_date(2013, 3, 17) AS `$col3__18`
) AS `project_scan_22`)

SELECT
`name__22` AS `name`,  
`department__23` AS `department`,  
`start_date__24` AS `start_date`,  
`rank__26` AS `rank`
FROM (
SELECT  
`name__22`,    
`department__23`,    
`start_date__24`,    
zetasqlite_window_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY `department__23` ORDER BY `start_date__24` ASC GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE TIES) AS `rank__26`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs26`.`name__19` AS `name__22`,      
`wrs26`.`department__20` AS `department__23`,      
`wrs26`.`start_date__21` AS `start_date__24`    
FROM `Employees` AS `wrs26`
) AS `with_ref_scan_26`  
ORDER BY `department__23` ASC, `start_date__24` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_25`;

### zigquery/functions/window/rank	rank with same order

SELECT  
1 AS `x__8`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
2 AS `x__8`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
2 AS `x__8`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
5 AS `x__8`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
8 AS `x__8`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
10 AS `x__8`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
10 AS `x__8`)

SELECT
`x__9` AS `x`,  
`rank__11` AS `rank`
FROM (

`x__9`,

FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs29`.`x__8` AS `x__9`    
FROM `Numbers` AS `wrs29`
) AS `with_ref_scan_29`  
ORDER BY `x__9` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_28`;

,

`wrs20`.`name__6` AS `name__14`    
FROM `T1` AS `wrs20`
) AS `with_ref_scan_20`  
ORDER BY `id__13` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

`$agg1__2`
FROM (

FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e030f02046e616d650403666f6f0376616c010a000000000000000f02046e616d6504036261720376616c0128000000000000000f02046e616d650403666f6f0376616c011400000000000000') AS `$array_3`
) AS `aggregate_scan_2`) ) AS `$col1`;

### zigquery/syntax/dml/merge	merge two tables with empty source
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
CREATE TABLE `target` (`id` INT,`name` TEXT) ;
CREATE TABLE `source` (`id` INT,`name` TEXT) ;
CREATE TABLE `zetasqlite_merged_table` AS SELECT DISTINCT
*
FROM (
SELECT  
`id__3` AS `merged_source_id`,    
`name__4` AS `merged_source_name`,    
`id__1` AS `merged_target_id`,    
`name__2` AS `merged_target_name`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__3`,      
`name` AS `name__4`    
FROM `source` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__1`,      
`name` AS `name__2`    
FROM `target` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` ON `id__1` = `id__3`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`id__3` AS `merged_source_id`,    
`name__4` AS `merged_source_name`,    
`id__1` AS `merged_target_id`,    
`name__2` AS `merged_target_name`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__1`,      
`name` AS `name__2`    
FROM `target` AS `T`
) AS `table_scan_3` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT    
`id` AS `id__3`,      
`name` AS `name__4`    
FROM `source` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` ON `id__1` = `id__3`
) AS `merged_union`;
UPDATE `target` SET `id`= `merged_source_id`,`name`= `merged_source_name` FROM zetasqlite_merged_table WHERE `merged_source_id` = `id` AND `merged_target_id` = `id`;
INSERT INTO `target` (`id`,`name`) SELECT `id__3` AS `id`,`name__4` AS `name` FROM (
SELECT  
`id` AS `id__3`,    
`name` AS `name__4`  
FROM `source` AS `S`
) AS `table_scan_4` WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM zetasqlite_merged_table WHERE `merged_source_id` = `id__3` AND `merged_target_id` IS NOT NULL);
DROP TABLE zetasqlite_merged_table;
SELECT
`id`,  
`name`
FROM `target`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `target`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `source`;

 (`id`, `name`)

 (`id`, `name`)

*
FROM (
SELECT  
`id__3` AS `merged_source_id`,

`name__2` AS `merged_target_name`

FROM `source`

### zigquery/syntax/query/array_subscript	array index access operator
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`item_array__2` AS `item_array`,  
`item_offset__3` AS `item_offset`,  
`item_ordinal__4` AS `item_ordinal`,  
`item_safe_offset__5` AS `item_safe_offset`
FROM (
WITH `Items` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'0e030406636f66666565040374656104046d696c6b' AS `item_array__1`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs8`.`item_array__1` AS `item_array__2`,    
zetasqlite_array_at_offset(`wrs8`.`item_array__1`, 1) AS `item_offset__3`,    
zetasqlite_array_at_ordinal(`wrs8`.`item_array__1`, 1) AS `item_ordinal__4`,    
zetasqlite_safe_array_at_offset(`wrs8`.`item_array__1`, 6) AS `item_safe_offset__5`  
FROM `Items` AS `wrs8`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/array_subscript	array boundary indexing test
SELECT
`$col1__3` AS `$col1`,  
`$col2__4` AS `$col2`,  
`$col3__5` AS `$col3`,  
`$col4__6` AS `$col4`
FROM (
WITH `toks` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'0e0204036f6e65040374776f' AS `digits__1`  )
  
SELECT  
zetasqlite_safe_array_at_ordinal(`wrs8`.`digits__1`, 2) AS `$col1__3`,    
zetasqlite_array_at_ordinal(`wrs8`.`digits__1`, 2) AS `$col2__4`,    
zetasqlite_array_at_offset(`wrs8`.`digits__1`, 1) AS `$col3__5`,    
zetasqlite_safe_array_at_offset(`wrs8`.`digits__1`, 1) AS `$col4__6`  
FROM `toks` AS `wrs8`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/array_subscript	out of range error
SELECT
`item_offset__3` AS `item_offset`
FROM (
WITH `Items` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'0e030406636f66666565040374656104046d696c6b' AS `item_array__1`  )
  
SELECT  
zetasqlite_array_at_offset(`wrs8`.`item_array__1`, 6) AS `item_offset__3`  
FROM `Items` AS `wrs8`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/conditional_expressions	case-when
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`val__1` AS `val`,  
`$col2__2` AS `$col2`
FROM (
SELECT  
`$array_4`.`value` AS `val__1`,    
CASE `$array_4`.`value` WHEN 1 THEN X'606f6e65' WHEN 2 THEN X'6074776f' WHEN 3 THEN X'607468726565' ELSE X'60666f7572' END AS `$col2__2`  
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e04010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000010400000000000000') AS `$array_4`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/conditional_expressions	case-when with compare
SELECT
`val__1` AS `val`,  
`$col2__2` AS `$col2`
FROM (
SELECT  
`$array_4`.`value` AS `val__1`,    
CASE WHEN `$array_4`.`value` > 3 THEN X'60666f7572' WHEN `$array_4`.`value` > 2 THEN X'607468726565' WHEN `$array_4`.`value` > 1 THEN X'6074776f' ELSE X'606f6e65' END AS `$col2__2`  
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e04010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000010400000000000000') AS `$array_4`
) AS `project_scan_3`;

) AS `project_scan_3`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/distinct	distinct union
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`x__5` AS `x`,  
`x__5` AS `y`
FROM (
WITH `toks` AS 	(  
SELECT    
true AS `x__1`,      
1 AS `y__2`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs8`.`x__1` AS `x__5`  
FROM `toks` AS `wrs8`  
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs8`.`x__1`)
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/except	except (case 627)
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
WITH `orders` AS 	(
SELECT  
5 AS `order_id__1`,    
X'607370726f636b6574' AS `item_name__2`,    
200 AS `quantity__3`)

SELECT
`wrs8`.`item_name__2` AS `item_name`,  
`wrs8`.`quantity__3` AS `quantity`
FROM `orders` AS `wrs8`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/except	except (case 628)
SELECT
`number__3` AS `number`
FROM (
SELECT  
`$array_6`.`value` AS `number__3`  
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000') AS `$array_6`  
EXCEPT  
SELECT  
1 AS `number__3`
) AS `set_op_scan_3`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/group_by	group by
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
WITH `Sales` AS 	(
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
8.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
4.56 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
2 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
1.0 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
4.25 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
0.99 AS `price__24`)

SELECT
`day__29` AS `day`,  
`total__28` AS `total`
FROM (
SELECT  
`wrs29`.`day__23` AS `day__29`,    
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`  
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`  
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`day__23`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_28`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/group_by	group by rollup with one column
WITH `Sales` AS 	(
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
8.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
4.56 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
2 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
1.0 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
4.25 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
0.99 AS `price__24`)

SELECT
`day__29` AS `day`,  
`total__28` AS `total`
FROM (
SELECT  
`day__29`,    
`total__28`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs29`.`day__23` AS `day__29`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`    
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`day__23`)    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
NULL AS `day`,      
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`    
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`    
GROUP BY NULL    
ORDER BY `wrs29`.`day__23` ASC
) AS `set_op_scan_inner`
) AS `aggregate_scan_28`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/group_by	group by rollup with two columns
SELECT
`sku__29` AS `sku`,  
`day__30` AS `day`,  
`total__28` AS `total`
FROM (
WITH `Sales` AS 	(  
SELECT    
123 AS `sku__22`,      
1 AS `day__23`,      
9.99 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
123 AS `sku__22`,      
1 AS `day__23`,      
8.99 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
456 AS `sku__22`,      
1 AS `day__23`,      
4.56 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
123 AS `sku__22`,      
2 AS `day__23`,      
9.99 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
789 AS `sku__22`,      
3 AS `day__23`,      
1.0 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
456 AS `sku__22`,      
3 AS `day__23`,      
4.25 AS `price__24`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
789 AS `sku__22`,      
3 AS `day__23`,      
0.99 AS `price__24`  )
  
SELECT  
`sku__29`,    
`day__30`,    
`total__28`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`sku__29`,      
`day__30`,      
`total__28`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`wrs29`.`sku__22` AS `sku__29`,        
`wrs29`.`day__23` AS `day__30`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`      
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`sku__22`), zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`day__23`)      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
`wrs29`.`sku__22` AS `sku__29`,        
NULL AS `day`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`      
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`      
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs29`.`sku__22`)      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
NULL AS `sku`,        
NULL AS `day`,        
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs29`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`      
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs29`      
GROUP BY NULL      
ORDER BY `wrs29`.`sku__22` ASC, `wrs29`.`day__23` ASC
) AS `set_op_scan_inner`
) AS `aggregate_scan_28`  
ORDER BY `sku__29` ASC, `day__30` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/group_by	group by having
WITH `Sales` AS 	(
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
8.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
1 AS `day__23`,    
4.56 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
123 AS `sku__22`,    
2 AS `day__23`,    
9.99 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
2 AS `day__23`,    
1.0 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
456 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
4.25 AS `price__24`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
789 AS `sku__22`,    
3 AS `day__23`,    
0.99 AS `price__24`)

SELECT
`day__29` AS `day`,  
`total__28` AS `total`
FROM (
SELECT  
`wrs30`.`day__23` AS `day__29`,    
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs30`.`price__24`) AS `total__28`,    
zetasqlite_sum(`wrs30`.`price__24`) AS `$agg2__30`  
FROM `Sales` AS `wrs30`  
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs30`.`day__23`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_29`
WHERE `$agg2__30` > 10.0;

### zigquery/syntax/query/group_by	group by struct values basic
SELECT
`person__6` AS `person`,  
`count__5` AS `count`
FROM (
SELECT  
`person__6`,    
`count__5`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`person__4` AS `person__6`,      
zetasqlite_count_star() AS `count__5`    
FROM (
SELECT      
X'0f02046e616d650405416c69636503616765011e00000000000000' AS `person__4`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'0f02046e616d650405416c69636503616765011e00000000000000' AS `person__4`      
UNION ALL      
SELECT      
X'0f02046e616d650403426f6203616765011900000000000000' AS `person__4`
) AS `set_op_scan_5`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`person__4`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `count__5` DESC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/group_by	group by struct values with aggregation

`total__11`

UNION ALL

UNION ALL

) AS `set_op_scan_5`

### zigquery/syntax/query/join	inner join with using
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
WITH `Roster` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'604164616d73' AS `LastName__11`,    
50 AS `SchoolID__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6042756368616e616e' AS `LastName__11`,    
52 AS `SchoolID__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60436f6f6c69646765' AS `LastName__11`,    
52 AS `SchoolID__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604461766973' AS `LastName__11`,    
51 AS `SchoolID__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60456973656e686f776572' AS `LastName__11`,    
77 AS `SchoolID__12`)
, 
`TeamMascot` AS 	(
SELECT  
50 AS `SchoolID__21`,    
X'604a616775617273' AS `Mascot__22`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
51 AS `SchoolID__21`,    
X'604b6e6967687473' AS `Mascot__22`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
52 AS `SchoolID__21`,    
X'604c616b657273' AS `Mascot__22`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
53 AS `SchoolID__21`,    
X'604d757374616e6773' AS `Mascot__22`)

SELECT
`SchoolID__24` AS `SchoolID`,  
`LastName__23` AS `LastName`,  
`Mascot__26` AS `Mascot`
FROM (
SELECT  
`wrs37`.`LastName__11` AS `LastName__23`,    
`wrs37`.`SchoolID__12` AS `SchoolID__24`  
FROM `Roster` AS `wrs37`
) AS `with_ref_scan_37` INNER JOIN (
SELECT  
`wrs38`.`SchoolID__21` AS `SchoolID__25`,    
`wrs38`.`Mascot__22` AS `Mascot__26`  
FROM `TeamMascot` AS `wrs38`
) AS `with_ref_scan_38` ON `SchoolID__24` = `SchoolID__25`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/join	left join
WITH `Roster` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'604164616d73' AS `LastName__11`,    
50 AS `SchoolID__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6042756368616e616e' AS `LastName__11`,    
52 AS `SchoolID__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60436f6f6c69646765' AS `LastName__11`,    
52 AS `SchoolID__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604461766973' AS `LastName__11`,    
51 AS `SchoolID__12`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60456973656e686f776572' AS `LastName__11`,    
77 AS `SchoolID__12`)
, 
`TeamMascot` AS 	(
SELECT  
50 AS `SchoolID__21`,    
X'604a616775617273' AS `Mascot__22`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
51 AS `SchoolID__21`,    
X'604b6e6967687473' AS `Mascot__22`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
52 AS `SchoolID__21`,    
X'604c616b657273' AS `Mascot__22`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
53 AS `SchoolID__21`,    
X'604d757374616e6773' AS `Mascot__22`)

SELECT
`LastName__23` AS `LastName`,  
`Mascot__26` AS `Mascot`
FROM (
SELECT  
`wrs37`.`LastName__11` AS `LastName__23`,    
`wrs37`.`SchoolID__12` AS `SchoolID__24`  
FROM `Roster` AS `wrs37`
) AS `with_ref_scan_37` LEFT JOIN (
SELECT  
`wrs38`.`SchoolID__21` AS `SchoolID__25`,    
`wrs38`.`Mascot__22` AS `Mascot__26`  
FROM `TeamMascot` AS `wrs38`
) AS `with_ref_scan_38` ON `SchoolID__24` = `SchoolID__25`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/join	join nested with

`id__1` AS `id`,  
`id__3` AS `id`

SELECT  
1 AS `id__1`
) AS `project_scan_5` LEFT JOIN (
WITH `tmp` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `id__2`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs12`.`id__2` AS `id__3`  
FROM `tmp` AS `wrs12`
) AS `with_scan_7` ON `id__1` = `id__3`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/limit	limit offset test
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
CREATE TABLE `IconNames` AS SELECT
`FirstName__5` AS `FirstName`,  
`LastName__6` AS `LastName`
FROM (
SELECT  
X'604b796c6965' AS `FirstName__5`,    
X'604d696e6f677565' AS `LastName__6`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60526f62796e' AS `FirstName__5`,    
null AS `LastName__6`
) AS `set_op_scan_4`;
INSERT INTO `IconNames`
 (`FirstName`, `LastName`) 
VALUES 
(X'60426a6f726b',null);
SELECT
`FirstName__1` AS `FirstName`,  
`LastName__2` AS `LastName`
FROM (
SELECT  
`FirstName__1`,    
`LastName__2`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`FirstName` AS `FirstName__1`,      
`LastName` AS `LastName__2`    
FROM `IconNames`
) AS `table_scan_5`  
ORDER BY `FirstName__1` ASC  
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
) AS `limit_scan_3`;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `IconNames`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/order_by	order by
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';

SELECT
`x__7` AS `x`,  
`y__8` AS `y`
FROM (

`x__7`,    
`y__8`  
FROM (
SELECT    
1 AS `x__7`,      
true AS `y__8`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
9 AS `x__7`,      
true AS `y__8`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
null AS `x__7`,      
false AS `y__8`
) AS `set_op_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `x__7` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

false AS `y__8`
) AS `set_op_scan_4`  
ORDER BY `x__7` IS NOT NULL DESC, `x__7` ASC
) AS `order_by_scan_3`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/pivot	PIVOT
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
WITH `produce` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'604b616c65' AS `product__37`,    
51 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605131' AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604b616c65' AS `product__37`,    
23 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605132' AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604b616c65' AS `product__37`,    
45 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605133' AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604b616c65' AS `product__37`,    
3 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605134' AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604b616c65' AS `product__37`,    
70 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605131' AS `quarter__39`,    
2021 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604b616c65' AS `product__37`,    
85 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605132' AS `quarter__39`,    
2021 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604170706c65' AS `product__37`,    
77 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605131' AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604170706c65' AS `product__37`,    
0 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605132' AS `quarter__39`,    
2020 AS `year__40`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'604170706c65' AS `product__37`,    
1 AS `sales__38`,    
X'605131' AS `quarter__39`,    
2021 AS `year__40`)

SELECT
`product__46` AS `product`,  
`year__47` AS `year`,  
`Q1__48` AS `Q1`,  
`Q2__49` AS `Q2`,  
`Q3__50` AS `Q3`,  
`Q4__51` AS `Q4`
FROM (
SELECT  
`wrs36`.`product__37` AS `product__46`,    
`wrs36`.`year__40` AS `year__47`,    
zetasqlite_sum((SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_is_not_distinct_from(`wrs36`.`quarter__39`, X'605131') THEN `wrs36`.`sales__38` ELSE null END AS `$col1__57`)) AS `Q1__48`,    
zetasqlite_sum((SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_is_not_distinct_from(`wrs36`.`quarter__39`, X'605132') THEN `wrs36`.`sales__38` ELSE null END AS `$col1__61`)) AS `Q2__49`,    
zetasqlite_sum((SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_is_not_distinct_from(`wrs36`.`quarter__39`, X'605133') THEN `wrs36`.`sales__38` ELSE null END AS `$col1__65`)) AS `Q3__50`,    
zetasqlite_sum((SELECT    
CASE WHEN zetasqlite_is_not_distinct_from(`wrs36`.`quarter__39`, X'605134') THEN `wrs36`.`sales__38` ELSE null END AS `$col1__69`)) AS `Q4__51`  
FROM `produce` AS `wrs36`  
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs36`.`product__37`), zetasqlite_group_by(`wrs36`.`year__40`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_34`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/qualify	qualify
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
WITH `Produce` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'606b616c65' AS `item__19`,    
23 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6062616e616e61' AS `item__19`,    
2 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'606672756974' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'6063616262616765' AS `item__19`,    
9 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606170706c65' AS `item__19`,    
8 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'606672756974' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606c65656b' AS `item__19`,    
2 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606c657474756365' AS `item__19`,    
10 AS `purchases__20`,    
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `category__21`)

SELECT
`item__22` AS `item`,  
`rank__26` AS `rank`
FROM (
SELECT  
`item__22`,    
`purchases__23`,    
`category__24`,    
zetasqlite_window_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY `category__24` ORDER BY `purchases__23` DESC GROUPS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW EXCLUDE TIES) AS `rank__26`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs28`.`item__19` AS `item__22`,      
`wrs28`.`purchases__20` AS `purchases__23`,      
`wrs28`.`category__21` AS `category__24`    
FROM `Produce` AS `wrs28`    
WHERE `wrs28`.`category__21` = X'60766567657461626c65'
) AS `filter_scan_27`  
ORDER BY `category__24` ASC, `purchases__23` DESC
) AS `analytic_scan_26`
WHERE `rank__26` <= 3;

### zigquery/syntax/query/qualify	qualify without group by / where / having

UNION ALL

### zigquery/syntax/query/qualify	qualify group

FROM (

`wrs11`.`item__1` AS `item__6`,

zetasqlite_sum(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_14`.`value`, 1)) AS `total_items__10`,      
zetasqlite_sum(zetasqlite_multiply(zetasqlite_cast(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_14`.`value`, 1), X'607b226e616d65223a22222c226b696e64223a322c227369676e61747572654b696e64223a302c22656c656d656e7454797065223a6e756c6c2c226669656c645479706573223a6e756c6c7d', X'607b226e616d65223a22222c226b696e64223a372c227369676e61747572654b696e64223a302c22656c656d656e7454797065223a6e756c6c2c226669656c645479706573223a6e756c6c7d', false), zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_14`.`value`, 2))) AS `total_cost__11`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`wrs15`.`order_id__5` AS `order_id__7`,        
`wrs15`.`items__6` AS `items__8`      
FROM `products` AS `wrs15`
) AS `with_ref_scan_15` CROSS JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(`items__8`) AS `$array_14`    
GROUP BY zetasqlite_group_by(`with_ref_scan_15`.`order_id__7`)
) AS `aggregate_scan_13`  
ORDER BY `order_id__12` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

INSERT INTO `users`
 (`user_id`, `tags`) 
VALUES

### zigquery/syntax/query/unnest	unnest struct with nested arrays
SELECT

`item_name__7` AS `item_name`,  
`qty__5` AS `qty`
FROM (
WITH `test_data` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'' AS `orders__1`  )
  
SELECT  
`order_id__6`,    
`item_name__7`,    
`qty__5`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`orders__2`,      
`o__3`,      
`item__4`,      
`qty__5`,      
`order_id__6`,      
`item_name__7`,      
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`o__3`, 0) AS `$orderbycol1__8`,      
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`item__4`, 0) AS `$orderbycol2__9`    
FROM (

`array_scan_12`.`orders__2`,        
`array_scan_12`.`o__3`,        
`array_scan_12`.`item__4`,        
`$array_11`.`value` AS `qty__5`,        
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`array_scan_12`.`o__3`, 0) AS `order_id__6`,

`$array_13`.`value` AS `o__3`

FROM `test_data` AS `wrs14`
) AS `with_ref_scan_14` CROSS JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(`orders__2`) AS `$array_13`
) AS `array_scan_13` CROSS JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`o__3`, 1)) AS `$array_12`

) AS `project_scan_9`

### zigquery/syntax/query/unnest	unnest struct with cross join
SELECT
`dept__7` AS `dept`,  
`manager__8` AS `manager`,  
`employee__9` AS `employee`
FROM (
WITH `departments` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'0e020f020464657074040b456e67696e656572696e67076d616e616765720405416c6963650f020464657074040553616c6573076d616e616765720403426f62' AS `dept_list__1`  )
,   
`employees` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'0e020f02046e616d650407436861726c69650464657074040b456e67696e656572696e670f02046e616d6504054469616e610464657074040553616c6573' AS `emp_list__2`  )
  
SELECT  
`dept__7`,    
`manager__8`,    
`employee__9`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`dept_list__3`,      
`d__4`,      
`emp_list__5`,      
`e__6`,      
`dept__7`,      
`manager__8`,      
`employee__9`,      
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`d__4`, 0) AS `$orderbycol1__10`,      
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`e__6`, 0) AS `$orderbycol2__11`    
FROM (
SELECT      
`join_scan_15`.`dept_list__3`,        
`join_scan_15`.`d__4`,        
`join_scan_15`.`emp_list__5`,        
`$array_14`.`value` AS `e__6`,        
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`join_scan_15`.`d__4`, 0) AS `dept__7`,        
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`join_scan_15`.`d__4`, 1) AS `manager__8`,        
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_14`.`value`, 0) AS `employee__9`      
FROM (
SELECT        
`dept_list__3`,          
`d__4`,          
`emp_list__5`        
FROM (
SELECT          
`with_ref_scan_17`.`dept_list__3`,            
`$array_16`.`value` AS `d__4`          
FROM (
SELECT            
`wrs17`.`dept_list__1` AS `dept_list__3`            
FROM `departments` AS `wrs17`
) AS `with_ref_scan_17` CROSS JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(`dept_list__3`) AS `$array_16`
) AS `array_scan_16` INNER JOIN (
SELECT          
`wrs18`.`emp_list__2` AS `emp_list__5`          
FROM `employees` AS `wrs18`
) AS `with_ref_scan_18`
) AS `join_scan_15` CROSS JOIN zetasqlite_unnest(`emp_list__5`) AS `$array_14`      
WHERE zetasqlite_equal(zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`join_scan_15`.`d__4`, 0), zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`$array_14`.`value`, 1))
) AS `project_scan_12`
) AS `project_scan_11`  
ORDER BY `$orderbycol1__10` ASC, `$orderbycol2__11` ASC
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/window_clause	window order by
WITH `toks` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'408000000000004d0b' AS `dt__9`,    
X'6063' AS `letter__10`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'408000000000004d2a' AS `dt__9`,    
X'6062' AS `letter__10`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'408000000000004d2a' AS `dt__9`,    
X'6063' AS `letter__10`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'408000000000004d47' AS `dt__9`,    
X'6061' AS `letter__10`)

SELECT
`dt__11` AS `dt`,  
`letter__12` AS `letter`,  
`rn__14` AS `rn`
FROM (
SELECT  
`dt__11`,    
`letter__12`,    
zetasqlite_window_row_number() OVER (ORDER BY `dt__11` ASC, `letter__12` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `rn__14`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs20`.`dt__9` AS `dt__11`,      
`wrs20`.`letter__10` AS `letter__12`    
FROM `toks` AS `wrs20`
) AS `with_ref_scan_20`  
ORDER BY `dt__11` ASC, `letter__12` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_19`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/window_clause	window order by handles nil
WITH `toks` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'408000000000004d0b' AS `dt__5`,    
X'6063' AS `letter__6`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'408000000000004d2a' AS `dt__5`,    
null AS `letter__6`)

SELECT
`dt__8` AS `dt`,  
`letter__9` AS `letter`,  
`rn__11` AS `rn`
FROM (
SELECT  
`dt__8`,    
`letter__9`,    
zetasqlite_window_row_number() OVER (ORDER BY `dt__8` ASC, `letter__9` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `rn__11`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs15`.`dt__5` AS `dt__8`,      
`wrs15`.`letter__6` AS `letter__9`    
FROM `toks` AS `wrs15`
) AS `with_ref_scan_15`  
ORDER BY `dt__8` ASC, `letter__9` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_14`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/window_clause	window range
WITH `Farm` AS 	(
SELECT  
X'60636174' AS `animal__19`,    
23 AS `population__20`,    
X'606d616d6d616c' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606475636b' AS `animal__19`,    
3 AS `population__20`,    
X'6062697264' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60646f67' AS `animal__19`,    
2 AS `population__20`,    
X'606d616d6d616c' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60676f6f7365' AS `animal__19`,    
1 AS `population__20`,    
X'6062697264' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'606f78' AS `animal__19`,    
2 AS `population__20`,    
X'606d616d6d616c' AS `category__21`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
X'60676f6174' AS `animal__19`,    
2 AS `population__20`,    
X'606d616d6d616c' AS `category__21`)

SELECT
`animal__22` AS `animal`,  
`population__23` AS `population`,  
`category__24` AS `category`,  
`similar_population__26` AS `similar_population`
FROM (
SELECT  
`animal__22`,    
`population__23`,    
`category__24`,    
zetasqlite_window_count_star() OVER (ORDER BY `population__23` ASC RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS `similar_population__26`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs26`.`animal__19` AS `animal__22`,      
`wrs26`.`population__20` AS `population__23`,      
`wrs26`.`category__21` AS `category__24`    
FROM `Farm` AS `wrs26`
) AS `with_ref_scan_26`  
ORDER BY `population__23` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_25`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/window_clause	window partitions are distinct from each other
WITH `inventory` AS 	(
SELECT  
`item__10`,    
`kind__11`,    
`purchases__12`  
FROM (
SELECT    
X'6062616e616e61' AS `item__10`,      
X'606672756974' AS `kind__11`,      
2 AS `purchases__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'606f6e696f6e' AS `item__10`,      
X'60766567657461626c65' AS `kind__11`,      
3 AS `purchases__12`    
UNION ALL    
SELECT    
X'606f72616e6765' AS `item__10`,      
X'606672756974' AS `kind__11`,      
4 AS `purchases__12`
) AS `set_op_scan_6`  
ORDER BY `item__10` ASC)

SELECT
`item__13` AS `item`,  
`purchases__15` AS `purchases`,  
`next_in_kind__18` AS `next_in_kind`,  
`next_best_seller__19` AS `next_best_seller`
FROM (
SELECT  
`item__13`,    
`kind__14`,    
`purchases__15`,    
zetasqlite_window_lead(`item__13`) OVER (PARTITION BY `kind__14` ORDER BY `item__13` ASC ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS `next_in_kind__18`,    
zetasqlite_window_lag(`item__13`) OVER (ORDER BY `purchases__15` ASC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS `next_best_seller__19`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs18`.`item__10` AS `item__13`,      
`wrs18`.`kind__11` AS `kind__14`,      
`wrs18`.`purchases__12` AS `purchases__15`    
FROM `inventory` AS `wrs18`
) AS `with_ref_scan_18`  
ORDER BY `kind__14` ASC, `item__13` ASC, `purchases__15` ASC
) AS `analytic_scan_17`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/with_cte	with clause
PRAGMA user_version;
SELECT 1 FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name = 'zetasqlite_catalog';
SELECT name, kind, spec FROM zetasqlite_catalog;
SELECT
`$col1__5` AS `$col1`
FROM (
WITH `sub1` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'0e02040161040162' AS `$col1__1`  )
,   
`sub2` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'0e02040163040164' AS `$col1__2`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs13`.`$col1__1` AS `$col1__5`  
FROM `sub1` AS `wrs13`  
UNION ALL  
SELECT  
`wrs16`.`$col1__2` AS `$col1__5`  
FROM `sub2` AS `wrs16`
) AS `with_scan_3`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/with_cte	subquery with
WITH `tmp` AS 	(
WITH `A` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `id__1`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs12`.`id__1` AS `id__2`  
FROM `A` AS `wrs12`)

SELECT
`wrs14`.`id__2` AS `id`
FROM `tmp` AS `wrs14`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/with_cte	nested with
WITH `output` AS 	(
WITH `sub` AS 	(  
SELECT    
`$array_8`.`value` AS `val__1`    
FROM zetasqlite_unnest(X'0e03010100000000000000010200000000000000010300000000000000') AS `$array_8`  )
  
SELECT  
`wrs11`.`val__1` AS `val__2`  
FROM `sub` AS `wrs11`  
WHERE `wrs11`.`val__1` > 1)

SELECT
`wrs13`.`val__2` AS `val`
FROM `output` AS `wrs13`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/with_cte	nested with 2
WITH `tmp` AS 	(
WITH `A` AS 	(  
SELECT    
1 AS `id__1`  )
,   
`B` AS 	(  
SELECT    
X'6068656c6c6f' AS `name__2`  )
  
SELECT  
`id__3`,    
`name__4`  
FROM (
SELECT    
`wrs16`.`id__1` AS `id__3`    
FROM `A` AS `wrs16`
) AS `with_ref_scan_16` INNER JOIN (
SELECT    
`wrs17`.`name__2` AS `name__4`    
FROM `B` AS `wrs17`
) AS `with_ref_scan_17`)

SELECT
`wrs19`.`id__3` AS `id`,  
`wrs19`.`name__4` AS `name`
FROM `tmp` AS `wrs19`;

### zigquery/syntax/query/with_cte	with ref scan maps column aliases correctly
CREATE TABLE `events` (`ID` TEXT,`DT` TEXT) ;
WITH `events_cte` AS 	(
SELECT  
`ID` AS `ID__1`,    
zetasqlite_extract_date(zetasqlite_parse_datetime(X'60256d2f25642f25792025483a254d', zetasqlite_nullif(`DT`, X'6030392f31372f32352030303a3030'))) AS `event_date__3`  
FROM `events`)

SELECT
`wrs9`.`ID__1` AS `event_id`,  
`wrs9`.`event_date__3` AS `occurrence_date`
FROM `events_cte` AS `wrs9`
WHERE zetasqlite_equal(zetasqlite_extract(`wrs9`.`event_date__3`, X'6059454152'), 2025);
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS `events`;

### zigquery/types/struct	struct field integration
CREATE TABLE `conductors` (`conductor` TEXT) ;
INSERT INTO `conductors`
 (`conductor`) 
VALUES 
(?);
SELECT
`length__2` AS `length`
FROM (
SELECT  
zetasqlite_get_struct_field(`conductor`, 0) AS `length__2`  
FROM `conductors`
) AS `project_scan_3`;
